english: Ooh, she sounds pretty confident, don't you think, Ryis?
french: Oh, elle a l'air sûre d'elle, tu ne trouves pas, Ryis ?
russian: У-у, она звучит уверенно, правда, Риз?
bulgarian: Ooh, she sounds pretty confident, don't you think, Ryis?

english: Wish I could say... I just deal the cards, man.
french: Je n'en sais rien... Moi, je donne les cartes.
russian: Не могу сказать... Я сегодня только на раздаче, друг.
bulgarian: Wish I could say... I just deal the cards, man.

english: I'm in for fifty more tesserae.
french: Je relance de cinquante tesserae.
russian: Я ставлю ещё пятьдесят тессер.
bulgarian: I'm in for fifty more tesserae.

english: Ho ho... that bluff won't work on me. Are you quite certain you don't need any more cards, Nora?
french: Ho ho... ça sent le coup de bluff. Tu es vraiment sûre que tu ne veux plus de cartes, Nora ?
russian: Хо-хо... Со мной такой блеф не пройдёт. Ты точно уверена, что тебе хватит карт, Нора?
bulgarian: Ho ho... that bluff won't work on me. Are you quite certain you don't need any more cards, Nora?

english: Are YOU sure you don't need any more cards, Errol?
french: Et TOI, Errol ? Es-tu sûr que tu ne veux plus de cartes ?
russian: А ТЫ уверен, что тебе хватит карт, Эррол?
bulgarian: Are YOU sure you don't need any more cards, Errol?

english: Now now, let's keep it friendly... no need to get worked up.
french: Allons, allons, on se calme... Inutile de se provoquer les uns les autres.
russian: Тихо, тихо, давайте по-хорошему... Не будем ссориться.
bulgarian: Now now, let's keep it friendly... no need to get worked up.

english: Hey guys, four of a kind is good, right? Or should I hold out for five of a kind? Guys?
french: Dites, quatre cartes identiques, c'est bien ? Ou il vaut mieux que j'attende d'en avoir cinq ? Les amis ?
russian: Ребята, каре — это вроде хорошо, да? Или лучше подождать пятой такой же? Ребята?
bulgarian: Hey guys, four of a kind is good, right? Or should I hold out for five of a kind? Guys?

english: Hit me.
french: Sers-moi.
russian: Ещё одну.
bulgarian: Hit me.

english: I didn't mind... he did treat us all to another round!
french: Moi, ça ne m'a pas gêné... vu qu'il a payé sa tournée après !
russian: А я и не расстроился... Всё равно он из выигрыша нас всех угостил!
bulgarian: I didn't mind... he did treat us all to another round!

english: Hit me.
french: Sers-moi.
russian: Ещё одну.
bulgarian: Hit me.

english: Don't think you can hide your reaction from me, Errol... I know all your tells!
french: On ne me la fait pas, à moi, Errol... Je connais tous tes trucs !
russian: Не думай, что я не вижу твоей реакции, Эррол... Я тебя насквозь вижу!
bulgarian: Don't think you can hide your reaction from me, Errol... I know all your tells!

english: The problem both of you have is that your little rivalry blinds you to the rest of the table. Isn't that right, Ryis?
french: Vous deux, votre problème, c'est que votre petite guéguerre vous empêche d'analyser ce qui se passe autour de la table. Pas vrai, Ryis ?
russian: Ваша проблема в том, ребята, что ваши перепалки мешают следить за остальным столом. Правда ведь, Риз?
bulgarian: The problem both of you have is that your little rivalry blinds you to the rest of the table. Isn't that right, Ryis?

english: I wouldn't know about that, Miss Terithia... I just like dealing and doing card tricks. Watch this!
french: Je n'en sais rien, madame Terithia... Moi, ce qui me plaît, c'est donner les cartes et faire des tours avec. Regardez ça !
russian: Откуда мне знать, мисс Теризия... Мне нравится стоять на раздаче и показывать фокусы. Вот, смотрите!
bulgarian: I wouldn't know about that, Miss Terithia... I just like dealing and doing card tricks. Watch this!

english: Whoaaaa, nice moves bro! By the way, is this a full house?
french: Ouah, pas mal ! Rien à voir, c'est un full, ça ?
russian: Ух ты-ы-ы, потрясно выглядит, бро! Кстати, это же фул-хаус?
bulgarian: Whoaaaa, nice moves bro! By the way, is this a full house?

english: Olric's four of a kind was beginner's luck... this time, the pot is mine.
french: Le carré d'Olric, c'était la chance du débutant... Cette fois-ci, c'est moi qui vais tout rafler.
russian: Ольрик просто новичок, вот ему и повезло с каре... На этот раз я заберу банк.
bulgarian: Olric's four of a kind was beginner's luck... this time, the pot is mine.

english: Yes... a truce... so we can take down Olric.
french: Oui... On fait une trêve... pour battre Olric.
russian: Да... Перемирие... Чтобы переиграть Ольрика.
bulgarian: Yes... a truce... so we can take down Olric.

english: I'm with you... I can't let Olric smudge my reputation...
french: Je vous suis. Je ne vais quand même pas laisser Olric ternir ma réputation...
russian: Я тоже с вами... Не позволю Ольрику запятнать мою репутацию...
bulgarian: I'm with you... I can't let Olric smudge my reputation...

english: Friends, is this really necessary? Olric's just having fun playing the game... he even bought us all dinner with his winnings last time.
french: C'est vraiment nécessaire, les amis ? Olric s'amuse, c'est tout... Il nous a même payé le dîner avec ses gains l'autre jour.
russian: Друзья, зачем вы так? Ольрик просто наслаждается игрой... В прошлый раз он даже оплатил нам всем ужин из выигрыша.
bulgarian: Friends, is this really necessary? Olric's just having fun playing the game... he even bought us all dinner with his winnings last time.

english: Besides, he couldn't possibly win a third time in a row... right?
french: Et puis, je ne vois pas comment il pourrait gagner trois fois de suite... pas vrai ?
russian: К тому же не может же он выиграть третий раз подряд... Правда?
bulgarian: Besides, he couldn't possibly win a third time in a row... right?

english: Hey uh, sorry I wasn't listening. Can anyone tell me what the difference between a regular flush and a royal flush is?
french: Désolé, je n'écoutais pas. Dites, quelqu'un peut me rappeler la différence entre une quinte flush et une quinte royale ?
russian: Ой, простите, я не слушал. Кто-нибудь может объяснить, чем отличаются обычный флеш и флеш-рояль?
bulgarian: Hey uh, sorry I wasn't listening. Can anyone tell me what the difference between a regular flush and a royal flush is?

english: We're in agreement, then?
french: Alors, on est d'accord ?
russian: Значит, договорились?
bulgarian: We're in agreement, then?

english: He must have a tell...
french: Il doit y avoir un truc...
russian: Как-то же его можно раскусить...
bulgarian: He must have a tell...

english: I've been watching him in every game this whole season... his game face is flawless... it's like there's nothing going on behind those eyes!
french: Je l'ai observé à chaque partie cette saison... Il ne laisse rien paraître. C'est comme s'il n'avait aucune émotion !
russian: Я слежу за его игрой весь сезон... У него идеальное лицо... Будто за этими глазами вообще ничего нет!
bulgarian: I've been watching him in every game this whole season... his game face is flawless... it's like there's nothing going on behind those eyes!

english: It's just a game, guys... don't get too hung up, you know?
french: Ce n'est qu'un jeu, les amis... Ne prenez pas tout ça trop au sérieux, d'accord ?
russian: Это же просто игра, ребята... Что вы такие взвинченные?
bulgarian: It's just a game, guys... don't get too hung up, you know?

english: No Ryis, they're right... his ability to win is UNNATURAL...
french: Non, Ryis. Ils ont raison... Ce n'est PAS NORMAL qu'il gagne à chaque fois !
russian: Нет, Риз, они правы... Так часто выигрывать — просто НЕНОРМАЛЬНО...
bulgarian: No Ryis, they're right... his ability to win is UNNATURAL...

english: Drinks are on me, guys! By the way, anyone wanna see this four-leaf clover I found?
french: Je paie ma tournée, les amis ! Au fait, vous voulez voir le trèfle à quatre feuilles que j'ai trouvé aujourd'hui ?
russian: Выпивка за мой счёт, ребята! Кстати, я сегодня нашёл клевер-четырёхлистник, хотите посмотреть?
bulgarian: Drinks are on me, guys! By the way, anyone wanna see this four-leaf clover I found?

english: I can't believe this... Olric won again.
french: Je n'arrive pas à le croire... Olric a encore gagné.
russian: Поверить не могу... Ольрик снова выиграл.
bulgarian: I can't believe this... Olric won again.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Dragons and Drama/dnd_1/dnd_1/1

french: J'ai mon personnage, [Ari]... C'est une druidesse qui parle aux fleurs et qui adore la nature ! Par contre, je ne sais pas quoi faire de tous ces chiffres...
russian: Я написала персонажу предысторию, [Ari]... Она друидка, умеет разговаривать с цветами и обожает природу! Но я не разобралась, что делать с цифрами...
bulgarian: I wrote a backstory for my character, [Ari]... she's a druid, and she can talk to flowers, and she loves nature! But I don't get what to do with all these numbers...

bulgarian: Follow my lead, Celine! I set all of these USELESS stats to 1 so my mind stat can be 67...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Dragons and Drama/dnd_3/dnd_3/2

french: Je... m'en occupe. J'utilise une de mes bénédictions d'émeraude pour invoquer un avocat. Oh, j'ai fait 1... Mince, ça veut dire que notre avocat est un... euh... un légume...

english: It's been a long road, and you've come to the end.

english: Certainly... better to turn your senses to one thing and give it the attention it deserves. Isn't that right, young March?

english: [ARI]! Come here, c'mere... I'll let you in on a little secret. You're not so bad... Haha. Oh, what was I saying again?

плохи

english: Oh my... it seems our young blacksmith is a bit of a lightweight.
french: Ça alors... On dirait que notre jeune forgeron ne tient pas l'alcool.
russian: Ой-ой... Кажется, у нашего юного кузнеца голова не очень крепка.

english: It's because he's drinking the cheap stuff... just like you, Valen. Having no palate is nothing to be ashamed of... here, try some of my wine. You'll see.
french: C'est parce qu'il boit de la piquette... comme toi, Valen. Mais il n'y a pas de honte à aimer ce qui est bon... Tiens, goûte ce vin. Tu verras la différence.
russian: Просто он пьёт дешёвую дрянь... Как и ты, Вален. Не иметь вкуса не зазорно... Вот, попробуй моё вино. Сразу поймёшь.
bulgarian: It's because he's drinking the cheap stuff... just like you, Valen. Having no palate is nothing to be ashamed of... here, try some of my wine. You'll see.

english: I suppose you've had plenty of time to refine your tastes, but as a doctor I simply can't recommend drinking at home, alone.
french: J'imagine que tu as eu le temps d'éduquer ton palais, mais en tant que médecin, je déconseille aux gens de boire seul chez eux.
russian: Я охотно верю, что у тебя было много времени натренировать свой вкус, но как врач я просто не могу поощрять употребление дома в одиночестве.
bulgarian: I suppose you've had plenty of time to refine your tastes, but as a doctor I simply can't recommend drinking at home, alone.

english: A girl can't get a little sloppy on a Monday night? This is why you have a reputation for being stiff, Valen.
french: Une jeune femme n'a-t-elle pas le droit de se détendre le soir en semaine ? Tu n'as pas la réputation d'être coincée pour rien, Valen.
russian: Девушка не может позволить себе маленькую шалость в понедельник вечером? Поэтому тебя и называют занудой, Вален.
bulgarian: A girl can't get a little sloppy on a Monday night? This is why you have a reputation for being stiff, Valen.

english: I have a reputation...?
french: J'ai cette réputation...?
russian: Меня кто-то так называет?..
bulgarian: I have a reputation...?

english: Come here and sit with me, [Ari]! The girls are fighting... what fun!
french: Viens t'asseoir à côté de moi, [Ari] ! J'adore regarder ces deux-là se crêper le chignon !
russian: Подсаживайся ко мне, [Ari]! Девочки сейчас поссорятся... вот это зрелище!
bulgarian: Come here and sit with me, [Ari]! The girls are fighting... what fun!

english: These other folks and their games... I like to really sit with a drink and appreciate it, you know what I mean?
french: Tous ces gens qui ne pensent qu'à jouer... Personnellement, je préfère siroter mon verre tranquillement.
russian: Эти ребята со своими играми... Мне больше нравится сесть и как следует насладиться напитком. Понимаете, о чём я?
bulgarian: These other folks and their games... I like to really sit with a drink and appreciate it, you know what I mean?

english: Juniper, I bought you some wine as a thank you for last time. Please, it's for you.
french: Juniper, je t'ai apporté une bouteille de vin pour te remercier pour la dernière fois. Tiens, c'est cadeau.
russian: Джунипер, я купила тебе вина. Хочу отблагодарить за прошлый раз. Пожалуйста, прими подарок.
bulgarian: Juniper, I bought you some wine as a thank you for last time. Please, it's for you.

english: Look at those two, getting along so well... bonding over a nice drink! That's what life's all about, if you ask me.
french: Regardez-les, comme les deux doigts de la main aujourd'hui, à partager un verre ! C'est ça, la vie, je vous le dis.
russian: Посмотрите на них, так хорошо поладили... сблизились за хорошей выпивкой! Я думаю, в этом и есть соль жизни.
bulgarian: Look at those two, getting along so well... bonding over a nice drink! That's what life's all about, if you ask me.

english: [Ari], do you think Juniper will let me try it? Maybe you can ask for me?
french: [Ari], tu crois que Juniper me laisserait goûter ce cru ? Tu peux lui demander ?
russian: [Ari], как думаешь, Джунипер даст мне попробовать? Можешь за меня попросить?
bulgarian: [Ari], do you think Juniper will let me try it? Maybe you can ask for me?

english: This is the most expensive bottle they keep behind the bar... It's not even on the menu.
french: C'est la bouteille la plus chère de l'auberge... Elle ne figure même pas sur la carte.
russian: Это самая дорогая бутылка из-под прилавка... Её же даже нет в меню.
bulgarian: This is the most expensive bottle they keep behind the bar... It's not even on the menu.

english: Oh, did I not mention? My father was a bit of a sommelier. We used to have this vintage with dinner.
french: Au fait, je ne t'avais jamais dit ? Mon père était un très grand amateur de vin. Nous buvions souvent ce cru au dîner.
russian: О, я не упоминала? Мой отец был слегка сомелье. У нас это вино подавали к ужину.
bulgarian: Oh, did I not mention? My father was a bit of a sommelier. We used to have this vintage with dinner.

english: You did not. Mention that.
french: Non... Tu ne l'avais jamais dit.
russian: Ты не упоминала. Такого.
bulgarian: You did not. Mention that.

english: Oh, how funny. Well, this is a dry wine, and aged in oak, so the taste is pleasantly full-bodied.
french: Oh, quelle tête de linotte ! Il s'agit d'un vin vieilli en fût de chêne, d'où sa rondeur et sa robe profonde.
russian: Ой, надо же. Что ж, это сухое вино, выдержанное в дубовой бочке, что придаёт вкусу приятную полнотелость.
bulgarian: Oh, how funny. Well, this is a dry wine, and aged in oak, so the taste is pleasantly full-bodied.

english: You might miss the sweetness, though- I've heard you have a bit of a sweettooth. One of those childish quirks that makes you so charming. Go on, give it a try.
french: Il ne sera peut-être pas assez moelleux à ton goût... À ce qu'il paraît, tu es très bec sucré. C'est l'un de ces côtés enfantins qui font ton charme. Vas-y, goûte.
russian: Правда, для тебя может быть недостаточно сладко... Я слышала, что ты сластёна. Одна из ребяческих черт, создающих твой особый шарм. Ну же, попробуй.
bulgarian: You might miss the sweetness, though- I've heard you have a bit of a sweettooth. One of those childish quirks that makes you so charming. Go on, give it a try.

english: IT'S... DELICIOUS... THANK YOU SO MUCH, THIS IS SO GENEROUS...
french: IL EST... DÉLICIEUX... MERCI, C'EST SI GÉNÉREUX DE TA PART...
russian: ОНО... ВОСХИТИТЕЛЬНО... СПАСИБО ОГРОМНОЕ, ЭТО ВЕЛИКАЯ ЩЕДРОСТЬ...
bulgarian: IT'S... DELICIOUS... THANK YOU SO MUCH, THIS IS SO GENEROUS...

english: Oh, my pleasure.
french: Oh, tout le plaisir est pour moi.
russian: Мне только в радость.
bulgarian: Oh, my pleasure.

english: I'll bet.
french: Je m'en doute.
russian: Ещё бы!
bulgarian: I'll bet.

english: Oh, [Ari]... you've arrived just in time for the show.
french: Ah, [Ari]... Tu arrives pile pour le spectacle.
russian: О, [Ari]... Ты как раз вовремя, сейчас начнётся.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]... you've arrived just in time for the show.

english: [Ari], you're here just in time! Juniper brought something truly special today... I've only heard stories about this wine.
french: [Ari], pile au bon moment ! Juniper a apporté un cru exceptionnel aujourd'hui... J'en avais souvent entendu parler.
russian: [Ari], ты как раз вовремя! Джунипер сегодня принесла кое-что особенное... Я про это вино только слышал.
bulgarian: [Ari], you're here just in time! Juniper brought something truly special today... I've only heard stories about this wine.

english: I haven't seen anyone this humiliated since the Count of Thornbrook, and we all know what happened to him... and if you don't, I'll tell you later [Ari].
french: Je dois remonter au comte de Thornbrook pour voir quelqu'un subir une telle humiliation, et nous savons tous ce qu'il lui est arrivé... Sinon, je te le dirai plus tard, [Ari].
russian: Я не видела подобного унижения со времён графа Торнбрука, и все мы знаем, как он закончил... Если не знаешь, [Ari], я тебе потом расскажу.
bulgarian: I haven't seen anyone this humiliated since the Count of Thornbrook, and we all know what happened to him... and if you don't, I'll tell you later [Ari].

english: O HO HO HO HO - ACK!
french: OH HO HO HO HO... ARGH !
russian: О-ХО-ХО-ХО-ХО... АЙ!
bulgarian: O HO HO HO HO - ACK!

english: The bottle!
french: La bouteille !
russian: Бутылка!
bulgarian: The bottle!

english: Juni knocked it over!
french: Juniper l'a renversée !
russian: Джуни её уронила!
bulgarian: Juni knocked it over!

english: There it goes... all over the floor.
french: Il y en a plein par terre.
russian: И всё... прямо на пол.
bulgarian: There it goes... all over the floor.

english: I'd offer you some, but my cup is quite empty. Thank you for sharing, Juniper.
french: Je vous en aurais bien donné, mais mon verre est déjà vide. En tout cas, merci, Juniper.
russian: Я бы поделилась, но мой бокал совершенно пуст. Спасибо, что угостила, Джунипер.
bulgarian: I'd offer you some, but my cup is quite empty. Thank you for sharing, Juniper.

english: Correction- THIS is the most humiliated I've seen someone since the Count of Thornbrook...
french: Au temps pour moi. Là, je n'avais jamais vu personne se faire humilier à ce point, à part le comte de Thornbrook...
russian: Уточнение: вот ТЕПЕРЬ я вижу величайшее унижение со времён графа Торнбрука...
bulgarian: Correction- THIS is the most humiliated I've seen someone since the Count of Thornbrook...

english: Gather around, everyone... for a once in a century occasion.
french: Approchez, les amis... pour un événement qui n'arrive qu'une fois dans une vie.
russian: Подходите поближе... Такое случается раз в сотню лет.
bulgarian: Gather around, everyone... for a once in a century occasion.

english: This is Witchvine Merlot... an 800 year old vintage that I brought with me to Mistria.
french: Voici un merlot de Sorcelierre... un vin de 800 ans d'âge que j'ai apporté dans mes valises en venant à Mistria.
russian: Это мерло ведьминой лозы... вино 800-летней выдержки, которое я привезла с собой в Мистрию.
bulgarian: This is Witchvine Merlot... an 800 year old vintage that I brought with me to Mistria.

english: Witchvine... Merlot...!
french: Un merlot... de Sorcelierre...!
russian: Мерло... ведьминой лозы!..
bulgarian: Witchvine... Merlot...!

english: Oh, you've heard of it? I suppose with your background you've heard stories.
french: Oh, tu connais ? Mais oui, suis-je bête ?! J'imagine que ton père a dû t'en parler.
russian: О, ты про него знаешь? Впрочем, ты должна была слышать рассказы, учитывая твою семью.
bulgarian: Oh, you've heard of it? I suppose with your background you've heard stories.

english: Yes, this is the real thing. And I think the first glass should go to Valen. For really opening my eyes to appreciating the finer things.
french: Oui, c'est une vraie. Je crois que Valen a droit d'y goûter en premier. Pour m'avoir ouvert les yeux sur les bonnes choses de la vie.
russian: Да, оно настоящее. И я думаю, первый бокал надо дать Вален. За то, что открыла мне мир утончённых удовольствий.
bulgarian: Yes, this is the real thing. And I think the first glass should go to Valen. For really opening my eyes to appreciating the finer things.

english: So... how is it? Don't hold back, doctor.
french: Alors, qu'en penses-tu ? N'hésite pas, doc.
russian: Ну... как тебе? Не стесняйся, докторша.
bulgarian: So... how is it? Don't hold back, doctor.

english: It's... unbelievable... transcendent. I love it...
french: Il... surpasse... tout. Je suis conquise...
russian: Просто... Невероятно... Бесподобно. Я в восторге...
bulgarian: It's... unbelievable... transcendent. I love it...

english: Well now. Isn't that nice?
french: Tiens donc. À la bonne heure !
russian: Ну и ну. Мило, правда?
bulgarian: Well now. Isn't that nice?

english: Sit with me, [Ari]! You're always so busy during the week...
french: Viens t'asseoir à côté de moi, [Ari] ! Tu n'arrêtes pas de la semaine...
russian:
Садись ко мне, [Ari]! Ты всю неделю так

заняты

занятазанятзанято...

english: Hoho! I shouldn't be getting rowdy at my age, but I'll have to show young March how we used to do things in my day!
french: Ho ho ! À mon âge, je ne devrais pas abuser, mais je vais montrer à ce gamin de March comment on buvait dans mon temps !
russian: Хо-хо! В моём возрасте не стоит буянить, но юному Марту надо показать, как мы кутили в былые деньки!
bulgarian: Hoho! I shouldn't be getting rowdy at my age, but I'll have to show young March how we used to do things in my day!

english: What a sweet boy March is. Sigh... [Ari], I've been having my fun with the theatrics these past few weeks, but poor Juniper does seem to be a bit down this week...
french: March est vraiment un gentil garçon. Pfff... [Ari], je me suis bien amusé à regarder ces deux-là se bouffer le nez dernièrement, mais cette pauvre Juniper a l'air déprimée aujourd'hui...
russian: Какой милый мальчик этот Март. *вздох*... [Ari], на прошлых встречах была прелюбопытная драма, но в этот раз бедная Джунипер правда выглядит подавленно.
bulgarian: What a sweet boy March is. Sigh... [Ari], I've been having my fun with the theatrics these past few weeks, but poor Juniper does seem to be a bit down this week...

english: It's not an 800 year old bottle of Witchvine Merlot, but I've got a bottle of red at home that tastes better with company.

russian: У меня нет 800-летнего мерло ведьминой лозы, но зато дома лежит бутылка красного, и оно явно вкуснее в компании.

english: Mm.
french: Mmm.

russian: У этого кузнеца весьма заурядные предпочтения в пиве, но... Это пойло всё же вкуснее, чем я ожидала.

english: It does, doesn't it?

russian: Точно, скажи ведь?
bulgarian: It does, doesn't it?

english: Cheers, Doctor.
french: Santé, doc.
russian: За здоровье, докторша.
bulgarian: Cheers, Doctor.

english: Juni spilled her fancy wine last week... but it's the thought that counts, and she was thinking of all of us when she brought it! So this week... DRINKS ARE ON ME! AWOOOOOOO!
french: Juniper a renversé son cru exceptionnel la semaine dernière... Enfin, c'est l'intention qui compte et elle pensait à nous en l'amenant ! Alors, ce soir... C'EST MOI QUI RINCE ! WOUHOU !

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_1/inn_folk_1_hemlock/init
english: Sometimes I can't tell if those two are friends or enemies... I suppose it isn't too important as long as they can share a drink.
french: Parfois, j'ai du mal à savoir si ces deux-là sont amies ou rivales... Mais peu importe, du moment qu'elles lèvent leur verre ensemble.

bulgarian: Eiland has been talking about this game of his for weeks... I hope the others are as excited as he is.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_1/inn_folk_1_reina/init
english: The Inn is so full! This is what I call a successful night... thanks for coming by and being a part of it, [Ari].

зашлазашёлзашло разделить его с нами, [Ari].

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_2/inn_folk_2_josephine/init

english: Wow, the cards table is hot tonight, [Ari]. Watch out...

russian: Ух, за карточным столом сегодня жарко, [Ari]. Осторожнее с ними...
bulgarian: Wow, the cards table is hot tonight, [Ari]. Watch out...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_3/inn_folk_3_hemlock/init
english: Juniper brought a bottle of Witchvine Merlot. Can you believe it? The stuff is legendary... maybe I can get a taste...
french: Juniper a apporté un merlot de Sorcelierre. Incroyable ! C'est un cépage légendaire... Je pourrais peut-être y tremper les lèvres...
russian: Джунипер принесла бутылку мерло ведьминой лозы. Ты представляешь? Это легендарное вино... Может, даст попробовать...
bulgarian: Juniper brought a bottle of Witchvine Merlot. Can you believe it? The stuff is legendary... maybe I can get a taste...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_3/inn_folk_3_josephine/init
english: You know, Balor pretends like Eiland's game is beneath him, but between you and me? I'd say he's getting into it. I saw him scribbling notes about his character earlier this week...
french: Balor répète que le jeu d'Eiland n'est pas assez bien pour lui, mais tu sais ce que j'en pense ? Que ça lui plaît ! Je l'ai vu avancer son personnage toute la semaine...
russian: Знаешь, Балор притворяется, что игра Эйланда ему неинтересна, но между нами скажу: он уже втянулся. На этой неделе я видела, как он писал заметки про персонажа...
bulgarian: You know, Balor pretends like Eiland's game is beneath him, but between you and me? I'd say he's getting into it. I saw him scribbling notes about his character earlier this week...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_3/inn_folk_3_reina/init
english: Dell, Maple and Luc have been sneaking around all night... you wouldn't know anything about that, would you, [Ari]? No, of course not...
french: Dell, Maple et Luc ont joué les petites souris toute la soirée... Tu ne sais pas ce qu'ils manigancent, [Ari] ? Non, évidemment...
russian: Делл, Мэйпл и Люк где-то прячутся весь вечер... Ты ведь ничего об этом не знаешь, так, [Ari]? Ну да, откуда тебе...
bulgarian: Dell, Maple and Luc have been sneaking around all night... you wouldn't know anything about that, would you, [Ari]? No, of course not...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_4/inn_folk_4_hemlock/init
english: You know, I've known March for a while, and it still surprises me that he's a happy drunk. It's kind of charming, actually.
french: Je connais March depuis un moment maintenant, et je suis toujours surpris par sa bonne humeur quand il a bu. C'est presque mignon.
russian: Знаешь, я давно знаком с Мартом, но до сих пор удивляюсь, что он добреет, когда пьяный. Вообще-то, это очень мило.
bulgarian: You know, I've known March for a while, and it still surprises me that he's a happy drunk. It's kind of charming, actually.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 1/Inn Folk/inn_folk_4/inn_folk_4_josephine/init
english: Things are getting heated over at Eiland's table... It sounds like it's all down to Snicklefritz... I mean Balor...
french: Ça chauffe à la table d'Eiland... Apparemment, tous les espoirs reposent sur Tirelaine, enfin... Balor, je veux dire.
russian: Атмосфера за столом Эйланда накаляется... Судя по всему, дело за Вихлешмыгом... В смысле, за Балором...
bulgarian: Things are getting heated over at Eiland's table... It sounds like it's all down to Snicklefritz... I mean Balor...

english: Snicklefritz... you came through for your friends in their time of need, when the chips were down... oh, I'm getting all misty!
french: Tirelaine... tu as su protéger tes amis quand ils en avaient besoin, alors que tout espoir était perdu... Ouh là, je m'emporte !
russian: Вихлешмыг... Ты спас друзей в трудную минуту, когда удача повернулась спиной... Ох, я сейчас расплачусь!
bulgarian: Snicklefritz... you came through for your friends in their time of need, when the chips were down... oh, I'm getting all misty!

english: The coast is clear...
french: La voie est libre...
russian: Всё чисто...
bulgarian: The coast is clear...

english: His secrets, more precisely. Why does he always keep his door locked? Is it because we keep trying to go in there uninvited? We're going to find out.
french: Enfin, ses secrets. Pourquoi est-ce que sa porte est toujours fermée à clé ? Parce qu'on a essayé d'entrer plusieurs fois sans y être invités ? On compte bien le découvrir.
russian: А точнее, его секреты. Почему его дверь всегда заперта? Неужели потому, что мы пытаемся пробраться туда без приглашения? Пришла пора разобраться.
bulgarian: His secrets, more precisely. Why does he always keep his door locked? Is it because we keep trying to go in there uninvited? We're going to find out.

english: Meet us here next week, [Ari]!
french: On se retrouve ici la semaine prochaine, [Ari] !
russian: Увидимся на следующей неделе, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Meet us here next week, [Ari]!

english: Now before we tell you anything, you have to pinky swear you won't tell anyone...
french: Avant qu'on te dise quoi que ce soit, tu dois nous jurer que tu ne diras rien à personne...
russian: Но мы тебе ничего не расскажем, пока не поклянёшься на мизинчике, что никому ни слова...
bulgarian: Now before we tell you anything, you have to pinky swear you won't tell anyone...

english: Because we're planning a HEIST!
french: On prépare un CASSE !
russian: Мы планируем НАЛЁТ!
bulgarian: Because we're planning a HEIST!

english: Luc is the brains...
french: Luc, c'est le cerveau...
russian: Люк будет нашими мозгами...
bulgarian: Luc is the brains...

english: Dell is the brawn...
french: Dell, c'est les muscles...
russian: Делл будет кулаками...
bulgarian: Dell is the brawn...

french: Moi, je suis leur façade...
russian: А я лицом...

russian:
А ты

посыльные

посыльнаяпосыльныйпосыльное, [Ari]!

russian: Псс, [Ari]! Не дай им себя заметить...

english: You're probably wondering what the plan is, [Ari].
french: Tu te demandes sûrement quel est notre plan, [Ari].
russian: Тебе, наверное, интересно, какой у нас план, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're probably wondering what the plan is, [Ari].

english: He'll sleep like a baby.
french: Il s'endormira en un rien de temps.
russian: Он уснёт как младенец.
bulgarian: He'll sleep like a baby.

english: And then you'll get his keys, [Ari]... and we'll look inside his room. Does everyone understand their role?
french: C'est là que tu lui piques ses clés, [Ari]... et qu'on va fouiller sa chambre. Tout le monde a compris ce qu'il doit faire ?
russian: Затем ты снимешь с него ключи, [Ari]... И мы заглянем к нему в комнату. Все поняли свои роли?
bulgarian: And then you'll get his keys, [Ari]... and we'll look inside his room. Does everyone understand their role?

english: Next week... is GO time. Rest up, [Ari].
french: La semaine prochaine... on met le plan à exécution. D'ici là, repose-toi bien, [Ari].
russian: На следующей неделе... ПРИДЁТ ЧАС. Отдохни хорошенько, [Ari].
bulgarian: Next week... is GO time. Rest up, [Ari].

english: I sure am.

russian: Мне точно интересно.
bulgarian: I sure am.

russian: По пятницам Рейна готовит картофель с сыром. А мы знаем, что от картофеля с сыром мистер Балор ОЧЕНЬ сонливый.
bulgarian: On Friday nights, Reina makes cheese & potatoes. Now, we all know cheese & potatoes makes Mister Balor VERY sleepy.

english: [Ari], you'll be the lookout.
french: [Ari], tu feras le guet.
russian: [Ari], будешь наблюдать.
bulgarian: [Ari], you'll be the lookout.

russian: А ты, Мэйпл, отвлеки Рейну. Она не может отказать, когда ты требуешь внимания.
bulgarian: Maple, you'll be the distraction. Reina can't say no when you want attention.

english: Naturally.
french: Bah oui, normal.

french: On avait prévu de mettre Balor hors d'état de nuire avec un plat de patates au fromage...
russian: Мы хотели усыпить Балора картофелем с сыром...
bulgarian: We were going to make Balor sleepy with cheese & potatoes...

bulgarian: Dell, he'll be IN his room. He'll be SO mad.

english: We'll be REALLY quiet.
french: On ne fera pas de bruit.
russian: Но мы ОЧЕНЬ тихо.
bulgarian: We'll be REALLY quiet.

russian: [Ari], лучше пока оставь дело нам, профессионалам... Мы отчитаемся об успехах на следующей неделе...
bulgarian: [Ari], you better leave this to us professionals... we'll report back next week...

french: Mais il n'y en a pas au menu cette semaine ! Comment ai-je pu ne pas penser à cette éventualité...?
russian: Но на этой неделе картофеля с сыром нет в меню! Как я мог так просчитаться...
bulgarian: But there's no cheese & potatoes on the menu this week! How did I miss this in my calculations...

french: Qu'est-ce qu'on fait ?
russian: И что нам делать?
bulgarian: So what do we do?

english: We improvise!
french: On improvise !
russian: Импровизировать!
bulgarian: We improvise!

english: Oh no... you know what happens when Dell improvises...
french: Oh non... On sait ce qui se passe quand Dell improvise.

bulgarian: It's never good...

french: MAIS NAN ! Bref, s'il faut que monsieur Balor dorme, frappons... au petit matin !
russian: ТАК ВОТ... Если мы хотим, чтобы мистер Балор спал, я считаю, надо выступать... НА ЗАРЕ!
bulgarian: ANYWAY... if we need Mister Balor to be asleep, I say we strike... at DAWN!

french: Bienvenue à cette troisième réunion du casse de la Garde des dragons... On a un problème.
russian: Добро пожаловать на третье обсуждение налёта Драконьей Стражи... У нас проблема.
bulgarian: Welcome to the third meeting of the Dragonguard Heist... there's a problem.

french: Dernière, parce qu'on est punis !
russian: Потому что нас ЗАПЕРЛИ дома!
bulgarian: Because we're GROUNDED!

english: Yeah...

french: Que c'est le bazar dans sa chambre !
russian: В его комнате УЖАСНЫЙ бардак.
bulgarian: His room is REALLY messy.

french: Mais vraiment ! Je n'aime pas trop ranger non plus, mais ça n'a jamais à ce point-là dans ma chambre...
russian: ТАКОЙ бардак. У меня тоже бардак, но мистер Балор на голову меня обошёл...
bulgarian: SO messy. I'm messy, but I could learn something from Mister Balor...

english: Is he even an adult? If you ask me, he's the one who should be grounded.
french: C'est indigne d'un adulte ! C'est lui qui devrait être puni.
russian: Он точно взрослый? По-моему, это его надо запереть дома.
bulgarian: Is he even an adult? If you ask me, he's the one who should be grounded.

english: It was a good plan, guys...
french: Mon plan était infaillible, les copains...
russian: Ребята, у нас был хороший план...
bulgarian: It was a good plan, guys...

english: Was it?
french: Ah bon ?
russian: Правда?
bulgarian: Was it?

russian: Ребята, у нас был план...
bulgarian: It was a plan, guys...

french: Mais il s'est réveillé immédiatement...
russian: И он немедленно проснулся...
bulgarian: And he woke up right away...

english: Guuuuys... it's not my fault he's a light sleeper!
french: Maiiis... Ce n'est pas de ma faute s'il a le sommeil léger !
russian: Ребя-а-ата... Я не виновата, что он так чутко спит!
bulgarian: Guuuuys... it's not my fault he's a light sleeper!

english: I hereby convene the fourth and final meeting of the Dragonguard Heist...
french: Je déclare ouverte la quatrième et dernière réunion du casse de la Garde des dragons !
russian: Итак, я объявляю четвёртое и последнее обсуждение налёта Драконьей стражи открытым!
bulgarian: I hereby convene the fourth and final meeting of the Dragonguard Heist...

english: Who in Mistria would survive on a deserted island?
french: À votre avis, qui, à Mistria, serait capable de survivre sur une île déserte ?
russian: Кто из мистрийцев мог бы выжить на необитаемом острове?
bulgarian: Who in Mistria would survive on a deserted island?

english: I suppose. Mostly I'm just glad it's not me on a deserted island.
french: C'est possible. En tout cas, une chose est sûre, je n'ai aucune envie de me retrouver sur une île déserte.
russian: Наверное. Я больше всего радуюсь, что меня не отправляют на необитаемый остров.
bulgarian: I suppose. Mostly I'm just glad it's not me on a deserted island.

english: Terithia! What a question! Let's see...
french: Terithia, en voilà une drôle de question ! Voyons voir...
russian: Ну и вопрос, Теризия! Давай подумаем...
bulgarian: Terithia! What a question! Let's see...

english: Balor enjoys his luxuries far too much, so he wouldn't last a day. Eiland, too. Our lord would expire without a slice of cake before bedtime.
french: Balor aime trop son petit confort. Il ne tiendrait pas un jour. Eiland non plus. Il ne tiendrait pas sans sa petite part de gâteau avant le coucher.
russian: Балор слишком любит роскошь, он и дня бы не продержался. Эйланд тоже. Наш юный лорд пропадёт без кусочка торта перед сном.
bulgarian: Balor enjoys his luxuries far too much, so he wouldn't last a day. Eiland, too. Our lord would expire without a slice of cake before bedtime.

english: Oh, they might surprise you. But I wouldn't say either is my first pick.
french: Ils pourraient vous surprendre, même si je ne parierais pas sur eux.
russian: Ой, они ещё могут тебя удивить. Но не скажу, что я выбрала бы кого-то из них.
bulgarian: Oh, they might surprise you. But I wouldn't say either is my first pick.

english: Holt would simply perish if he didn't have someone else to hear his jokes. On the other hand, Adeline would have the island organized in short order.
french: Holt mourrait s'il n'avait personne pour écouter ses blagues et ses jeux de mots. Quant à Adeline, je pense qu'elle réorganiserait toute l'île en moins de deux.
russian: Хольт просто погибнет, если некому будет рассказывать шутки. А вот Аделина быстро навела бы на острове порядок.
bulgarian: Holt would simply perish if he didn't have someone else to hear his jokes. On the other hand, Adeline would have the island organized in short order.

english: Aye, that girl's no stranger to rolling up her sleeves. What do you think, [Ari]? Anyone in mind?
french: Oui, le travail ne lui fait pas peur. Et toi, [Ari], tu penses à qui ?
russian:
Да, эта девчонка не чурается работы руками. Что думаешь, [Ari]? Кого бы ты

выбрали

выбралавыбралвыбрало?
bulgarian: Aye, that girl's no stranger to rolling up her sleeves. What do you think, [Ari]? Anyone in mind?

english: Reina! She can make a meal out of anything!
french: À Reina ! Elle te fait un repas avec un rien !
russian: Рейну! Она из чего угодно приготовит обед!
bulgarian: Reina! She can make a meal out of anything!

english: Hayden! He's so self-reliant!
french: À Hayden ! Il est parfaitement autonome !
russian: Хейдена! Он такой самодостаточный!
bulgarian: Hayden! He's so self-reliant!

english: My thoughts exactly.
french: Je me disais exactement la même chose.
russian: Я тоже так думаю.
bulgarian: My thoughts exactly.

english: Unlike me, [Ari]. Can you imagine, ME on a deserted island? I would simply give up.
french: Pas comme moi, [Ari] ! Tu m'imagines sur une île déserte ? Je me laisserai mourir.
russian: Не то что я, [Ari]. Можешь представить МЕНЯ на необитаемом острове? Я бы сразу сдалась.
bulgarian: Unlike me, [Ari]. Can you imagine, ME on a deserted island? I would simply give up.

english: He's like you, isn't he? He'd have some crops going and animals befriended before the week was out.
french: Il est comme toi, pas vrai ? Il ferait pousser des récoltes et domestiquerait les animaux de l'île en moins d'une semaine.
russian: В этом он похож на тебя. У него к концу недели уже был бы огород и пара прирученных животных.
bulgarian: He's like you, isn't he? He'd have some crops going and animals befriended before the week was out.

english: Juniper, [Ari]! Let me ask you a question...
french: Juniper, [Ari] ! J'ai une question pour vous...
russian: Джунипер, [Ari]! У меня к вам вопрос...
bulgarian: Juniper, [Ari]! Let me ask you a question...

english: Is that their way of telling me I should take a vacation?
french: C'est leur manière de me dire de prendre des vacances ?
russian: Они так пытаются сказать, что мне пора съездить в отпуск?
bulgarian: Is that their way of telling me I should take a vacation?

english: Juniper and Terithia flagged me down earlier, asking how I'd cultivate a deserted island.
french: Juniper et Terithia m'ont demandé comment je ferais pour cultiver les terres sur une île déserte.
russian: Джунипер и Теризия недавно меня обступили и стали спрашивать, как бы я культивировал необитаемый остров.
bulgarian: Juniper and Terithia flagged me down earlier, asking how I'd cultivate a deserted island.

english: Anyway, I gave them Papa's tropical punch recipe and they seemed really happy!
french: Je leur ai donné la recette du punch tropical de papa, elles étaient aux anges !
russian: В общем, я им дала папин рецепт тропического пунша. Они обе очень обрадовались!
bulgarian: Anyway, I gave them Papa's tropical punch recipe and they seemed really happy!

english: Juniper and Terithia have been asking for island recipes. Are they going on vacation?
french: Juniper et Terithia m'ont demandé des recettes à cuisiner sur une île. Elles ont prévu de partir en vacances ?
russian: Джунипер и Теризия в последнее время спрашивают меня про рецепты островной кухни. Они что, планируют поездку?
bulgarian: Juniper and Terithia have been asking for island recipes. Are they going on vacation?

english: It's a perfectly normal thing to wonder about! Who in Mistria would make the best frog?
french: Pour moi, c'est une question tout à fait légitime ! Qui, à Mistria, ferait le plus beau crapaud ?
russian: По-моему, совершенно нормально задаваться таким вопросом! Из кого в Мистрии вышла бы лучшая лягушка?
bulgarian: It's a perfectly normal thing to wonder about! Who in Mistria would make the best frog?

english: I haven't had enough wine for this conversation.
french: Je n'ai pas encore assez bu pour ce genre de conversation.
russian: Мне нужно больше вина для таких разговоров.
bulgarian: I haven't had enough wine for this conversation.

english: Oh. Yes. It seems so obvious when you put it like that.
french: Mais oui. Quand tu le dis, ça paraît évident.
russian: О, да. Когда ты так говоришь, сразу кажется очевидным.
bulgarian: Oh. Yes. It seems so obvious when you put it like that.

english: It really fits, doesn't it?
french: Toi aussi, hein ?
russian: Ему подходит, правда?
bulgarian: It really fits, doesn't it?

english: But I've got our real answer. It's Errol! Have you seen that man's legs in a bathing suit?
french: Mais je sais. C'est Errol ! Vous avez déjà vu ses cannes quand il est en maillot de bain ?
russian: Но у меня есть правильный ответ. Это Эррол! Вы видели его ноги в купальном костюме?
bulgarian: But I've got our real answer. It's Errol! Have you seen that man's legs in a bathing suit?

english: March would run through all his energy trying to jump higher than the other frogs. Landen would croak up a storm and drive the rest off.
french: March consacrerait toute son énergie à essayer de sauter plus haut que les autres crapauds. Landen croasserait sans s'arrêter et ferait fuir tout le monde.
russian: Март бы истратил все силы, пытаясь прыгнуть выше других лягушек. Ланден бы наквакал грозу и отпугнул всех вокруг.
bulgarian: March would run through all his energy trying to jump higher than the other frogs. Landen would croak up a storm and drive the rest off.

english: What about Ryis? He seems the type to be content with the simple life.
french: Et Ryis ? C'est le genre de garçon qui a l'air d'aimer les choses simples.
russian: Как насчёт Риза? Кажется, этот парень не против жить в простоте.
bulgarian: What about Ryis? He seems the type to be content with the simple life.

english: He's a city boy, Juniper. No frogs in the city.
french: Il vient de la ville, Juniper. Il n'y a pas de crapauds en ville.
russian: Он городской мальчик, Джунипер. В городе нет лягушек.
bulgarian: He's a city boy, Juniper. No frogs in the city.

english: Surely you've got some thoughts, [Ari]! Who do you think would make the best frog?
french: Tu dois avoir un avis là-dessus, [Ari] ! Qui ferait le meilleur crapaud selon toi ?
russian: [Ari], у тебя наверняка есть идеи! Из кого вышла бы лучшая лягушка?
bulgarian: Surely you've got some thoughts, [Ari]! Who do you think would make the best frog?

english: Juniper! The Bathhouse is like your pond!
french: Juniper ! Les bains me font penser à une mare !
russian: Из Джунипер! А купальня — это твой пруд!
bulgarian: Juniper! The Bathhouse is like your pond!

english: Olric! He loves sitting on rocks!
french: Olric ! Il adore se poser sur les rochers !
russian: Из Ольрика! Он обожает сидеть на камнях!
bulgarian: Olric! He loves sitting on rocks!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that, [Ari].
french: Je vais faire comme si je n'avais rien entendu, [Ari].
russian: Я притворюсь, что не слышала, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that, [Ari].

english: Now now, I think you'd make an adorable little frog. One of those poisonous ones.
french: Allons, tu ferais un adorable petit crapaud. Comme ceux qui sont super venimeux.
russian: Ну-ну, я думаю, из тебя вышла бы очаровательная лягушка. Из тех, что маленькие и ядовитые.
bulgarian: Now now, I think you'd make an adorable little frog. One of those poisonous ones.

english: Besides, we all know the real answer. It has to be Errol! Have you seen that man's legs in a bathing suit?
french: Et puis, on sait tous qui ce serait : Errol ! Vous avez déjà vu ses guiboles quand il est en maillot de bain ?
russian: А вообще, мы все знаем правильный ответ. Это точно Эррол! Вы видели его ноги в купальном костюме?
bulgarian: Besides, we all know the real answer. It has to be Errol! Have you seen that man's legs in a bathing suit?

english: Ahoy there, [Ari]! Help me answer Juniper's strange question.
french: Ohé, [Ari] ! Tu pourrais m'aider à répondre à cette drôle de question que m'a posée Juniper ?
russian: Здорово, [Ari]! Помоги-ка мне ответить на странный вопрос Джунипер.
bulgarian: Ahoy there, [Ari]! Help me answer Juniper's strange question.

english: You wouldn't happen to know why, would you?
french: Tu ne saurais pas pourquoi, par le plus grand des hasards ?
russian: Ты, случайно, не знаешь, почему?
bulgarian: You wouldn't happen to know why, would you?

english: Ah, I can tell by your expression that I shouldn't pursue the matter further.
french: Ah, vu ta tête, je crois que je ferais mieux de ne pas insister.
russian: Ага, по твоему выражению лица я могу понять, что лучше мне не копать глубже.
bulgarian: Ah, I can tell by your expression that I shouldn't pursue the matter further.

english: [Ari], I couldn't help but notice that Terithia and Juniper were both pointing at me the other night.
french: [Ari], j'ai remarqué que Terithia et Juniper regardaient en me pointant du doigt l'autre soir.
russian: [Ari], я не мог не заметить, что Теризия и Джунипер показывали на меня вчера вечером.
bulgarian: [Ari], I couldn't help but notice that Terithia and Juniper were both pointing at me the other night.

english: Who here would make the best pirate?
french: Qui ferait le meilleur pirate ?
russian: Кто из здешних был бы лучшим пиратом?
bulgarian: Who here would make the best pirate?

english: Oho, I was born to answer this question. Errol would look dashing with a tricorn hat, but he gets a tad seasick. Hemlock strikes me as a right salty dog.
french: Ho ho, je suis née pour répondre à cette question. Errol serait superbe avec un tricorne, mais il a le mal de mer. Je verrais bien Hemlock aussi.
russian: О-хо, я рождена для этого вопроса! Эррол в треуголке выглядел бы сногсшибательно, но у него морская болезнь. У Хемлока есть задатки настоящего морского волка.
bulgarian: Oho, I was born to answer this question. Errol would look dashing with a tricorn hat, but he gets a tad seasick. Hemlock strikes me as a right salty dog.

english: And Nora would make a fearful captain, but a fair one. Oh, it's difficult to choose!
french: Nora ferait une capitaine redoutée, mais juste. Argh, c'est dur de décider !
russian: А Нора была бы грозной капитаншей, но слишком честной. Ох, как трудно выбрать!
bulgarian: And Nora would make a fearful captain, but a fair one. Oh, it's difficult to choose!

english: March has that look in his eye that says everyone is his enemy. He might even pull off an eyepatch.
french: March a un regard qui fusille tout le monde. Il aurait de l'allure avec un cache-œil.
russian: У Марта взгляд так и кричит, что все вокруг — его враги. Может, ему даже пошла бы повязка.
bulgarian: March has that look in his eye that says everyone is his enemy. He might even pull off an eyepatch.

english: What do you think, [Ari]?
french: Et pour toi, [Ari], ce serait qui ?
russian: Что думаешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: What do you think, [Ari]?

english: Dell, Maple and Luc! They play pirates all the time.
french: Dell, Maple et Luc ! Ils jouent tout le temps aux pirates.
russian: Делл, Мэйпл и Люк! Они всё время играют в пиратов.
bulgarian: Dell, Maple and Luc! They play pirates all the time.

english: Elsie! She'd plunder everyone's hearts!
french: Elsie ! Elle ferait une razzia sur les cœurs !
russian: Элси! Она готова украсть сердце любого!
bulgarian: Elsie! She'd plunder everyone's hearts!

english: I have to throw in with [Ari] on this one, Terithia. They're half pirate already!
french: Là, je suis d'accord avec [Ari], Terithia. Ils sont déjà à moitié pirates !
russian:
Тут я вынуждена признать, что [Ari]

правы

праваправправо, Теризия. Они уже почти пираты!
bulgarian: I have to throw in with [Ari] on this one, Terithia. They're half pirate already!

english: Mistria's original rapscallions.
french: Les petits pirates en herbe de Mistria.
russian: Настоящие мистрийские пройдохи.
bulgarian: Mistria's original rapscallions.

english: She does have a heart of adventure.
french: C'est vrai qu'elle a un côté aventureux.
russian: У неё и правда душа лежит к приключениям.
bulgarian: She does have a heart of adventure.

english: She'd be the siren of the sea! No one could resist her charms.
french: Ce serait une véritable sirène ! Personne ne résisterait à son charme.
russian: Она была бы морской сиреной! Перед её чарами никому не устоять.
bulgarian: She'd be the siren of the sea! No one could resist her charms.

english: Now Terithia, I've put a lot of thought into this question, so I hope you'll take it seriously. Same to you, [Ari].
french: Terithia, j'ai longuement mûri ma question, alors j'espère que tu y répondras sérieusement. Ça vaut aussi pour toi, [Ari].
russian: Итак, Теризия, я много думала над этим вопросом, так что надеюсь, ты воспримешь его всерьёз. Как и ты, [Ari].
bulgarian: Now Terithia, I've put a lot of thought into this question, so I hope you'll take it seriously. Same to you, [Ari].

english: I can't say I have, but there's always time.
french: Eh bien, non, mais il n'est jamais trop tard.
russian: Не могу пока похвастаться, но время ещё есть.
bulgarian: I can't say I have, but there's always time.

english: Juniper asked if I'd ever romanced a pirate, and Terithia asked me the same thing later.
french: Juniper m'a demandé si j'avais déjà eu une aventure avec un pirate. Terithia aussi.
russian: Джунипер спросила, соблазняла ли я пирата, а затем Теризия задала тот же вопрос.
bulgarian: Juniper asked if I'd ever romanced a pirate, and Terithia asked me the same thing later.

english: Well, I'm adorable, and Dell would make a great pirate.
french: Moi, je suis à croquer et Dell ferait une super pirate.
russian: Ну, я очаровательная, а Делл будет отличной пираткой.
bulgarian: Well, I'm adorable, and Dell would make a great pirate.

english: Arrrrr matey!
french: À l'abordaaaage !
russian: Р-р-разрази меня гром!
bulgarian: Arrrrr matey!

english: Juniper said we would make adorable pirates.
french: Juniper a dit qu'on ferait des pirates à croquer.
russian: Джунипер сказала, что из нас выйдут очаровательные пираты.
bulgarian: Juniper said we would make adorable pirates.

english: Sorcerers? That's a fairy tale, Juniper.
french: Le meilleur sorcier ? Mais ça n'existe pas, Juniper.
russian: Чародеем? Это же сказки, Джунипер.
bulgarian: Sorcerers? That's a fairy tale, Juniper.

english: Hmm. Bet he could.
french: Mmm, il faut voir.
russian: Хмм. Уверена, он бы справился.
bulgarian: Hmm. Bet he could.

english: I can see it. She has a curious mind, and an eye for herbs, which are two of the basic tenets of potion-making.
french: Je vois, je vois. Elle est curieuse et elle sait reconnaître les plantes, deux compétences essentielles pour fabriquer des potions.
russian: Могу понять. У неё есть пытливый ум и знание трав, а это две основы, на которых строится изготовление зелий.
bulgarian: I can see it. She has a curious mind, and an eye for herbs, which are two of the basic tenets of potion-making.

english: But I frankly don't think she could pull off the wardrobe.
french: Mais elle ne serait pas au niveau sur le plan vestimentaire.
russian: Но, честно говоря, не думаю, что она выдержит стиль.
bulgarian: But I frankly don't think she could pull off the wardrobe.

english: Hmm. Bet she could.
french: Mmm, il faut voir.
russian: Хмм. Уверена, она бы справилась.
bulgarian: Hmm. Bet she could.

english: Of course, of course. But Terithia, we proposed starting a pirate crew last week! Work with me here.
french: Oui, oui, bien sûr. Mais Terithia, on s'est posé la question pour un équipage de pirates la semaine dernière, alors fais un effort.
russian: Конечно, конечно. Но, Теризия, на прошлой неделе мы уже придумали пиратскую команду! Помоги мне.
bulgarian: Of course, of course. But Terithia, we proposed starting a pirate crew last week! Work with me here.

english: Fair enough. Let's see now, Eiland's read a lot of old books about the Witch Queens... but I'd say that's where his interest ends.
french: Bon, d'accord. Voyons voir... Eiland a beaucoup lu de vieux bouquins sur les Reines-sorcières... mais je crois que ça ne l'intéresse pas plus que ça.
russian: Действительно. Давай посмотрим, Эйланд много читал о королевах-ведьмах... Но я бы сказала, что на этом его интерес заканчивается.
bulgarian: Fair enough. Let's see now, Eiland's read a lot of old books about the Witch Queens... but I'd say that's where his interest ends.

english: March has a knack for creating things, but he's a bit rigid otherwise.
french: March sait fabriquer beaucoup de choses, mais il est un peu trop rigide en dehors de ça.
russian: У Марта талант создавать вещи, но в остальном он довольно твердолобый.
bulgarian: March has a knack for creating things, but he's a bit rigid otherwise.

english: Josephine does give me pause. She has a way of moving through the world.
french: J'hésite pour Joséphine... Elle a une façon bien à elle d'aborder la vie.
russian: Джозефина заставляет задуматься. У неё как будто особый способ взаимодействия с миром.
bulgarian: Josephine does give me pause. She has a way of moving through the world.

english: What about Valen?
french: Et Valen ?
russian: А как насчёт Вален?
bulgarian: What about Valen?

english: I won't even dignify that with a response. [Ari], speak up! Your thoughts are wanted. And no picking yourself!
french: Je ne daignerai même pas répondre. [Ari], à toi ! On veut ton avis. Et ne te choisis pas toi-même !
russian: Предположение, недостойное моего ответа. [Ari], выскажись! Нам нужны твои мысли. Себя не выбирать!
bulgarian: I won't even dignify that with a response. [Ari], speak up! Your thoughts are wanted. And no picking yourself!

english: Hayden! Henrietta is like his familiar!
french: Hayden ! Et il a déjà Henrietta comme animal totem !
russian: Хейден! А Генриетта — его фамильяр!
bulgarian: Hayden! Henrietta is like his familiar!

english: Celine! The way her flowers bloom is magical!
french: Céline ! Ce don qu'elle a pour faire pousser les fleurs, c'est de la sorcellerie !
russian: Селин! Какие у неё получаются цветы — просто волшебство!
bulgarian: Celine! The way her flowers bloom is magical!

english: Interesting. And I do see it. He has a strong connection to his animals, and a connection to the land as well.
french: Intéressant... C'est vrai qu'il a un lien très fort avec ses animaux, mais aussi avec la terre.
russian: Любопытно. Понимаю ход мысли. У него есть сильная связь с животными, а также связь с землёй.
bulgarian: Interesting. And I do see it. He has a strong connection to his animals, and a connection to the land as well.

english: But I frankly don't think he could pull off the wardrobe.
french: Mais il ne serait pas au niveau sur le plan vestimentaire.
russian: Но, честно говоря, не думаю, что он выдержит стиль.
bulgarian: But I frankly don't think he could pull off the wardrobe.

english: My, look at all those people down there. We've got a full house. I wonder which of them would make the best sorcerer?

english: Silver can do it. He's so let down by the Dragonhawk, this is his origin story... this is how he becomes a DARK BIRDWATCHER. I activate Shadow Eye and shoot the keystone!
french: Silvère en est capable. Il est tellement déçu par Faldragon, le but de son existence ici... qu'il se transforme en ORNITHOLOGUE INFERNAL. J'active l'Œilnoir et je tire sur la pierre !
russian: Сильвер может. Ястреб-дракон его так подвёл, ведь это была его предыстория... Теперь он становится ТЁМНЫМ ПТИЦЕЛОВОМ. Я активирую Глаза Тени и стреляю в замковый камень!
bulgarian: Silver can do it. He's so let down by the Dragonhawk, this is his origin story... this is how he becomes a DARK BIRDWATCHER. I activate Shadow Eye and shoot the keystone!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/5
english: A class change in the middle of battle? I'll allow it. The keystone shatters!
french: Un changement de classe en plein combat ? OK, j'accepte. La clé de voûte se brise en mille morceaux !
russian: Смена класса посреди битвы? Ладно, я разрешаю. Замковый камень рассыпался.
bulgarian: A class change in the middle of battle? I'll allow it. The keystone shatters!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/6
english: Demonlord Blood falls to the ground, trapped by his awkward conversation with Supreme Grimblade, made even more awkward by his graceless tumble.
french: Le seigneur démon Sang tombe à terre, pris dans cet échange bizarre avec Funestia la démoniste suprême, échange rendu encore plus saugrenu par cette chute peu esthétique.
russian: Лорд демонов Кровь падает на землю, пока колдунья Клинок Тьмы отвлекает его неудобным разговором, который после неуклюжего падения становится ещё более неудобным.
bulgarian: Demonlord Blood falls to the ground, trapped by his awkward conversation with Supreme Grimblade, made even more awkward by his graceless tumble.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/7
english: I roll to show Demonlord Blood the pages of my architectural digest, hoping to turn him from the ways of evil architecture. I rolled a... twenty?!
french: Je lance le dé pour montrer les pages de mon traité d'architecture au seigneur démon Sang, en espérant le détourner à jamais de l'architecture. J'obtiens un... 20 ?!
russian: Я делаю бросок, чтобы лорд демонов Кровь посмотрел на страницы моего архитектурного сборника и надеюсь отвратить его с пути архитектуры зла. Я выкинул... двадцать?!
bulgarian: I roll to show Demonlord Blood the pages of my architectural digest, hoping to turn him from the ways of evil architecture. I rolled a... twenty?!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/8
english: The digest slips from your hand, striking Blood's weak spot. The demon coughs and begins to burn with demonic fire. He rasps his final words at you.
french: Le compendium t'échappe et frappe le point faible du seigneur démon. Celui-ci se met à suffoquer et prend feu. D'une voix rauque, il prononce ses derniers mots.
russian: Сборник выпадает у тебя из рук и падает на слабое место Крови. Демон кашляет и сгорает в демоническом пламени. Скрежещущим голосом он бросает вам последние слова.
bulgarian: The digest slips from your hand, striking Blood's weak spot. The demon coughs and begins to burn with demonic fire. He rasps his final words at you.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/9
english: Do the voice!
french: Faites la voix !
russian: Покажи голос!
bulgarian: Do the voice!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Balor's Gate/balors_gate_4/balors_gate_4/init
english: Friends, I must apologize... my eagerness to study the tower led to our capture by Demonlord Blood. Look at us now. Defeated. And we've learned nothing!
french: Mes amis, saurez-vous me pardonner ? C'est à cause de mon envie d'étudier cette tour que nous avons été capturés par le seigneur démon. Nous sommes vaincus. Et nous n'avons rien appris !
russian: Друзья, я должен извиниться... Из-за моего рвения исследовать башню нас захватил лорд демонов Кровь. И где мы теперь? Повержены. И не узнали ничего нового!
bulgarian: Friends, I must apologize... my eagerness to study the tower led to our capture by Demonlord Blood. Look at us now. Defeated. And we've learned nothing!

english: Ahahaha... since you mention it, I was in the middle of documenting quality control standards... which I should probably get back to...
french: Ah ha ha ha... Maintenant que tu le dis, j'étais en train de rédiger nos normes d'assurance qualité... et je ferais mieux de m'y remettre...
russian: А-ха-ха... Ты верно подметила, я как раз занималась документацией стандартов контроля качества... И, вероятно, мне стоит продолжить...
bulgarian: Ahahaha... since you mention it, I was in the middle of documenting quality control standards... which I should probably get back to...

english: Sorry to see you go. How about one drink before you hit the road?
french: C'est dommage que tu partes. Tu ne veux pas un petit quelque chose pour la route ?
russian: Грустно, что ты уходишь. Может, ещё бокальчик — и в путь?
bulgarian: Sorry to see you go. How about one drink before you hit the road?

english: Oh, that tastes just heavenly! Try this, [Ari]!
french: Oh, mais c'est délicieux ! Goûte, [Ari] !
russian: Ого, просто райский вкус! Попробуй, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Oh, that tastes just heavenly! Try this, [Ari]!

english: Hot, sweet and fruity, with a little bite... that's whiskey, I surmise?
french: C'est chaud, sucré et fruité, avec une petite pointe de... whisky, c'est ça ?
russian: Горячий, сладкий, фруктовый, с небольшой остротой... Подозреваю, там виски?
bulgarian: Hot, sweet and fruity, with a little bite... that's whiskey, I surmise?

english: It's like hot tea with a little something extra! More of that extra for me, please.
french: On dirait du thé chaud avec un petit truc en plus ! J'en veux bien encore un peu.
russian: Это как горячий чай с особыми добавками! Мне, пожалуйста, ещё этих добавок.
bulgarian: It's like hot tea with a little something extra! More of that extra for me, please.

english: I want to wrap myself up in this drink like a blanket, it's so cozy! What is it?
french: C'est tellement agréable à boire qu'on a l'impression de se blottir sous une couette ! C'est quoi ?
russian: Я хочу завернуться в этот напиток, как в тёплый плед: такой он уютный! Что это?
bulgarian: I want to wrap myself up in this drink like a blanket, it's so cozy! What is it?

english: Hot toddy. Hot water, lemon, honey, and a splash of whatever you like. Thought something simple after a complicated week was just the thing.
french: Un grog. Eau chaude, citron, miel et une lichette de ce que vous voulez. Je me suis dit que quelque chose de simple vous ferait du bien après une semaine éreintante.
russian: Горячий тодди. Горячая вода, лимон, мёд и немного чего душа пожелает. Я решил, что после трудной недели стоит попробовать что-нибудь простенькое.
bulgarian: Hot toddy. Hot water, lemon, honey, and a splash of whatever you like. Thought something simple after a complicated week was just the thing.

english: Maybe you're right. And you know, I think it's very important I quality control this drink.
french: Finalement, je crois que j'ai changé d'avis. C'est important que je contrôle la qualité de cette boisson aussi.
russian: Наверное, ты прав. И, знаешь, я думаю, мне надо провести контроль качества этого напитка.
bulgarian: Maybe you're right. And you know, I think it's very important I quality control this drink.

english: That'd be mighty helpful of you.
french: Je t'en serais très reconnaissant.
russian: Буду весьма благодарен.
bulgarian: That'd be mighty helpful of you.

english: Ohhh, I know that look, Adeline, you're thinking of going back to work! Keep your behind parked in that chair!
french: Oh, je connais ce regard, Adeline... Tu as envie de retourner travailler ! N'essaie même pas de te lever de cette chaise !
russian: О-о, узнаю это выражение лица, Аделина. Ты собираешься уйти работать! Может, не будешь пока слезать со стула?
bulgarian: Ohhh, I know that look, Adeline, you're thinking of going back to work! Keep your behind parked in that chair!

english: I'm overrun with mint this year! Hayden called it a bumper crop. I brought more, take it!
french: Cette année, j'ai de la menthe à ne plus savoir qu'en faire ! Hayden a dit que c'était une récolte exceptionnelle. Je t'en ai apporté plus, d'ailleurs !
russian: У меня в этом году просто заросли мяты! Хейден говорит, что это небывалый урожай. Я ещё принесла, возьмите.
bulgarian: I'm overrun with mint this year! Hayden called it a bumper crop. I brought more, take it!

english: Nice, I can pretty up drinks with the fresh stuff. And... there we are, mint gimlets all around. Give them a go!
french: Parfait, je pourrai décorer les verres avec les feuilles fraîches. Et... voilà des Gimlets menthe pour tout le monde. Allez-y, goûtez !
russian: Отлично, можно украсить напитки свежими веточками. Вот так... Всем мятный «буравчик». Попробуйте!
bulgarian: Nice, I can pretty up drinks with the fresh stuff. And... there we are, mint gimlets all around. Give them a go!

english: Oh! It's so cute! And green! And it tastes so minty! And herby!
french: Oh, comme c'est joli ! Et vert ! On sent bien la menthe et les herbes !
russian: Ой! Он такой милый! Зелёный! И такой мятный вкус! Очень травянистый!
bulgarian: Oh! It's so cute! And green! And it tastes so minty! And herby!

english: And fresh! And limey!
french: C'est frais ! Et citronné !
russian: И такая свежесть от лайма!
bulgarian: And fresh! And limey!

english: Hemlock used to mix me one of these after a long, hot day in the Mines. Oh, happy days... no matter the time of year, this is the taste of summer!
french: Hemlock me préparait ça après une longue journée dans la chaleur de la mine. C'était le bon vieux temps... Ça a un petit quelque chose d'estival, quelle que soit la saison !
russian: Хемлок раньше мне его делал после долгого жаркого дня в шахтах. Эх, славные были деньки... в любое время года он даёт вкус лета!
bulgarian: Hemlock used to mix me one of these after a long, hot day in the Mines. Oh, happy days... no matter the time of year, this is the taste of summer!

english: It's so refreshing! This drink and I were mint to be together.
french: C'est tellement rafraîchissant ! C'est le genre de boisson qui « t'aimenthe » les papilles.
russian: И так освежает! Самый аромятный напиток в моей жизни.
bulgarian: It's so refreshing! This drink and I were mint to be together.

english: Thanks to Celine, I've got it bottled up behind the counter now, so come back for the taste of summer any time. You too, [Ari]!
french: Grâce à Céline, j'en ai préparé quelques bouteilles, alors revenez quand vous voulez pour goûter à l'été. Toi aussi, [Ari] !
russian: Благодаря Селин у меня за стойкой ещё много бутылок, так что возвращайтесь за вкусом лета, когда захотите. И ты тоже, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks to Celine, I've got it bottled up behind the counter now, so come back for the taste of summer any time. You too, [Ari]!

english: Thanks for bringing all that mint by earlier this week, Celine. Reina cooked it down and got a nice syrup out of it, so we've got something special today.
french: Merci de m'avoir apporté toute cette menthe cette semaine, Céline. Reina en a fait du sirop, alors je vous ai préparé une surprise pour aujourd'hui.
russian: Спасибо, что принесла столько мяты на неделе, Селин. Рейна сварила из неё отличный сироп, так что сегодня у нас кое-что необычное.
bulgarian: Thanks for bringing all that mint by earlier this week, Celine. Reina cooked it down and got a nice syrup out of it, so we've got something special today.

english: I know you're a coffee fan, so I've been experimenting since last time I saw Darcy at the Market. Took weeks to get the flavor right!
french: Je sais que tu adores le café, alors j'ai fait quelques essais après le dernier passage de Darcy au marché. Il m'a fallu des semaines pour obtenir ce goût !
russian: Я знаю, что ты фанат кофе, так что я встретился с Дарси на базаре и начал экспериментировать. Несколько недель ушло, чтобы сбалансировать вкус!
bulgarian: I know you're a coffee fan, so I've been experimenting since last time I saw Darcy at the Market. Took weeks to get the flavor right!

english: Not even a pun? Now that's a first.
french: Même pas un petit jeu de mots ? C'est bien la première fois.
russian: Даже без каламбура? Вот это редкость.
bulgarian: Not even a pun? Now that's a first.

english: Now, we've got two to one of our base liquor and the coffee liqueur, over ice. That's a nice molasses color, isn't it?
french: Alors, deux doses de liqueur de base pour une de café sur de la glace. Ça a une jolie couleur brune, non ?
russian: Теперь у нас базовый ликёр с кофейным ликёром два к одному, плюс лёд. Приятный оттенок патоки, да?
bulgarian: Now, we've got two to one of our base liquor and the coffee liqueur, over ice. That's a nice molasses color, isn't it?

english: It looks a bit... bitter. Unless...
french: Ça a l'air un peu... amer. À moins que...
russian: Слегка... горько. А может...
bulgarian: It looks a bit... bitter. Unless...

english: You know it. Reina whipped up some sweet heavy cream for us. Now, a big, generous ladle on top...
french: Tu as tout compris. Reina nous a préparé une petite chantilly maison. J'en ajoute une bonne couche sur le dessus...
russian: Конечно. Специально для нас Рейна приготовила густые взбитые сливки. Ложку побольше тебе в стакан, вот так...
bulgarian: You know it. Reina whipped up some sweet heavy cream for us. Now, a big, generous ladle on top...

english: Oh my gosh. It looks scrumptious!
french: Oh là là, mais c'est délicieux !
russian: Боже мой, выглядит восхитительно!
bulgarian: Oh my gosh. It looks scrumptious!

english: You're an artist, Hemlock. Cheers!
french: C'est du grand art, Hemlock. Santé !
russian: Ты просто художник, Хемлок. Твоё здоровье!
bulgarian: You're an artist, Hemlock. Cheers!

english: Look at the cream blend with the coffee! It looks like a heavy mist over the mountains...
french: Regardez la crème fondre dans le café ! Ça fait comme une brume ouatée qui tombe sur la montagne...
russian: Смотрите, как сливки ложатся на кофе! Как будто густой туман в горах...
bulgarian: Look at the cream blend with the coffee! It looks like a heavy mist over the mountains...

english: Now that's a pretty name. We'll call it a Heavy Mist! So, what do you think Holt?
french: C'est joli, ça. On va l'appeler Brume ouatée ! Et toi, tu trouves ça comment, Holt ?
russian: Вот и красивое название. Пускай будет «Плотный туман»! Ну, что думаешь, Хольт?
bulgarian: Now that's a pretty name. We'll call it a Heavy Mist! So, what do you think Holt?

english: Can't! Talk! Too... busy... drinking!
french: Peux ! Pas ! Parler ! Je... savoure !
russian: Не! Могу! Говорить! Занят... Пью!
bulgarian: Can't! Talk! Too... busy... drinking!

english: You absolute madman. You did it. Coffee liqueur!
french: Incroyable... Tu as réussi à préparer de la liqueur de café !
russian: Ну ты и безумец. Ты правда его сделал. Кофейный ликёр.
bulgarian: You absolute madman. You did it. Coffee liqueur!

english: This is something we used to make after a long day in the Mines. It went by many names! Rock Juice, the Mineshaft, Blood from the Stone, the Sinkhole...
french: C'est la boisson qu'on préparait après notre journée à la mine. Ce cocktail a plein de noms : Houille houille houille, Bonne pioche, Pella Colada, Haut-fourneau...
russian: Этот напиток мы делали после долгого дня в шахтах. У него много названий! «Каменный сок», «Скважина», «Кровь из камня», «Воронка»...
bulgarian: This is something we used to make after a long day in the Mines. It went by many names! Rock Juice, the Mineshaft, Blood from the Stone, the Sinkhole...

english: Oh, you're all giving up in favor a normal drink? That's how we did it in the old days, too.
french: Quoi ?! Vous préférez une boisson ordinaire plutôt que mon cocktail ? C'est ce qu'on faisait à l'époque aussi.
russian: О, вы отказываетесь в пользу обычного напитка? Мы так тоже делали в былые дни.
bulgarian: Oh, you're all giving up in favor a normal drink? That's how we did it in the old days, too.

english: What about you, [Ari]? You can have a beer, but someone's got to, ah, handle this Bucket Brew.
french: Et toi, [Ari] ? Tu peux prendre une bière, mais quelqu'un doit, euh... goûter mon Coup de grisou.
russian: Что насчёт тебя, [Ari]? Можешь взять пиво, но кому-то придётся, эмм, выдержать это «Шахтёрское пойло».
bulgarian: What about you, [Ari]? You can have a beer, but someone's got to, ah, handle this Bucket Brew.

english: Bucket Brew me!
french: OK, envoie !
russian: «Шахтёрского пойла» мне!
bulgarian: Bucket Brew me!

english: I'll stick with beer.
french: Je reste à la bière.
russian: Мне лучше пиво.
bulgarian: I'll stick with beer.

english: Hoho, you're an adventurous one! That's the spirit!
french: Ho ho, quel esprit aventureux ! J'adore !
russian: Хо-хо, вот она, страсть к приключениями! Авантюрный дух!
bulgarian: Hoho, you're an adventurous one! That's the spirit!

english: You've wisdom beyond your years, [Ari].
french: Visiblement, la sagesse n'attend pas le nombre des années, [Ari].
russian:
Ты

мудры

мудрамудрмудро не по годам, [Ari].
bulgarian: You've wisdom beyond your years, [Ari].

english: Helmet Hash, Miner's Mash, Bucket Brew...
french: Coup de grisou, Mine fizz, Hysterril...
russian: «Горняцкое месиво», «Шахтёрское пойло», «Колодезная брага»...
bulgarian: Helmet Hash, Miner's Mash, Bucket Brew...

english: So what was the recipe?
french: C'était quoi, la recette ?
russian: Так каков рецепт?
bulgarian: So what was the recipe?

english: Well, it wasn't a recipe so much as we all poured whatever dregs we had into a canteen and gave it a good shake!
french: Oh, rien de très élaboré. On mettait tout ce qui nous tombait sous la main dans un bidon et on secouait bien !
russian: Да нет особенного рецепта, мы просто сливали всё, что оставалось, в одну флягу и трясли как следует!
bulgarian: Well, it wasn't a recipe so much as we all poured whatever dregs we had into a canteen and gave it a good shake!

english: Errol, as the one responsible for the wellbeing of this town, I have to ask. What was safer, the Mines or this drink?
french: Errol, en tant que responsable de cette ville, je dois vous demander... Qu'est-ce qui était le moins dangereux : la mine ou ce mélange ?
russian: Эррол, как ответственная за благосостояние города, я обязана спросить. Что было опаснее: шахты или это пойло?
bulgarian: Errol, as the one responsible for the wellbeing of this town, I have to ask. What was safer, the Mines or this drink?

english: Hah! You're quite a card, Lady Adeline.
french: Ha ! Vous êtes perspicace, dame Adeline.
russian: Ха! У вас язык остёр, леди Аделина.
bulgarian: Hah! You're quite a card, Lady Adeline.

english: He didn't answer the question, did he?
french: Il n'a pas répondu à la question, si ?
russian: Разве он ответил на вопрос?
bulgarian: He didn't answer the question, did he?

english: He sure didn't...
french: Oh, non...
russian: Не ответил...
bulgarian: He sure didn't...

english: How about a round of beers instead?
french: Et si on buvait plutôt de la bière ce soir ?
russian: Может, лучше всем по пиву?
bulgarian: How about a round of beers instead?

english: Hemlock's been so generously mixing the drinks the past few weeks, I thought I'd share a recipe of my own!
french: Hemlock nous a tellement régalés avec ses cocktails que j'ai décidé de lui révéler une de mes spécialités cette semaine !
russian: Хемлок так расщедрился с коктейлями в последние недели, что я тоже решил предложить свой рецепт!
bulgarian: Hemlock's been so generously mixing the drinks the past few weeks, I thought I'd share a recipe of my own!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/1
english: I joined the drawing club because I want to start sketching my animals. They grow up so fast, you know?
french: Je me suis inscrit au club de dessin pour faire des portraits de mes animaux. Ils grandissent si vite, tu sais.
russian: Я вступил в кружок, потому что хочу делать зарисовки своих животных. Не замечаешь, как быстро они растут!
bulgarian: I joined the drawing club because I want to start sketching my animals. They grow up so fast, you know?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/2
english: Valen's the model this week! I thought she'd be quite stiff, but she actually seems very comfortable in her poses.
french: C'est Valen qui pose pour nous cette semaine ! Je pensais qu'elle serait tendue, mais elle est parfaitement à l'aise.
russian: На этой неделе наша модель — Вален! Я боялась, что она будет немного скованной, но оказалось, что она легко позирует.
bulgarian: Valen's the model this week! I thought she'd be quite stiff, but she actually seems very comfortable in her poses.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/3
english: An understanding of muscle groups is a must in my line of work. Now, are you ready? Next pose!
french: Comprendre les groupes musculaires est indispensable dans mon métier. Bien, vous êtes prêts pour la pose suivante ?
russian: Моя работа требует знания, как работают группы мышц. Итак, вы готовы? Меняю позу!
bulgarian: An understanding of muscle groups is a must in my line of work. Now, are you ready? Next pose!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/4
english: Wait, I'm still drawing! I can't create a masterpiece under these conditions.
french: Attends, je n'ai pas terminé ! Jamais je ne pourrai dessiner un chef-d'œuvre dans ces conditions.
russian: Погоди, я не дорисовал! С такими требованиями я не могу создать шедевр.
bulgarian: Wait, I'm still drawing! I can't create a masterpiece under these conditions.

russian: Меня лично впечатляет, что Эйланд скупает имущество и ничего с ним не делает! Наверняка в твоей империи можно найти ему применение?
