key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/10
english: I wonder if there's more to Lords of the Land than we think.
french: Je me demande si Seigneurs des terres ne cache pas autre chose...
russian: Любопытно. Возможно, «Владыки земель» скрывают больше, чем мы думали.
bulgarian: I wonder if there's more to Lords of the Land than we think.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/2
english: But I have, Nora! It's my duty to preserve these historical buildings. I'm leaving them intact.
french: Mais il sert à quelque chose, Nora ! Mon devoir moral est de préserver ces bâtiments historiques, alors je n'y touche pas.
russian: А я и нашёл, Нора! Мой долг — сохранить эти исторические здания. Я поддерживаю их первозданный вид.
bulgarian: But I have, Nora! It's my duty to preserve these historical buildings. I'm leaving them intact.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/3
english: But you had it all declared landmarks! No one has any place to live!
french: Mais tu les as tous déclarés monuments historiques ! Plus personne ne peut se loger !
russian: Ты все их назначил достопримечательностями! Людям просто негде жить!
bulgarian: But you had it all declared landmarks! No one has any place to live!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/4
english: That's why Celine and I pooled our black market bucks to get around the law. You see, Eiland may have bought the buildings, but I bought the deeds to the land.
french: C'est pour ça que Céline et moi avons mis en commun nos gains sur le marché noir pour contourner la loi. Eiland a acheté les bâtiments, mais c'est moi qui détiens les titres de propriété sur les terres.
russian: Поэтому мы с Селин объединили наши заработки с чёрного рынка и обошли закон. Видишь ли, Эйланд скупил все здания, но права на землю купил я.
bulgarian: That's why Celine and I pooled our black market bucks to get around the law. You see, Eiland may have bought the buildings, but I bought the deeds to the land.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/5
english: I'm going to level it to make room for my newest development... an amusement park!
french: Je vais tout raser pour réaliser mon projet de... parc d'attractions !
russian: Вот это я снесу, чтобы освободить место для новостройки... Тут будет парк развлечений!
bulgarian: I'm going to level it to make room for my newest development... an amusement park!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/6
english: Welcome... to Holtland.
french: Bienvenue à... Holtland.
russian: Добро пожаловать... в Хольтленд.
bulgarian: Welcome... to Holtland.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/7
english: You said we'd call it Celineland!
french: Tu avais dit que ça s'appellerait Célineland !
russian: Ты говорил, что это будет Селинленд!
bulgarian: You said we'd call it Celineland!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/8
english: For a silly little board game, it certainly induces people to act unlike themselves.
french: Ce jeu de société semble pousser les gens à se comporter différemment.
russian: Хотя это всего лишь настольная игра, она меняет поведение людей до неузнаваемости.
bulgarian: For a silly little board game, it certainly induces people to act unlike themselves.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/9
english: It raises the collective blood pressure of the table, too...
french: Et il fait monter la tension de tout le monde autour de la table...
russian: Кроме того, она повышает коллективное кровяное давление за столом...
bulgarian: It raises the collective blood pressure of the table, too...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/init
english: This game is riveting, Eiland. You said it's called Lords of the Land?
french: Je trouve ce jeu fascinant, Eiland. Tu as dit qu'il s'appelait « Seigneurs des terres » ?
russian: Впечатляющая игра, Эйланд. Говоришь, она называется «Владыки земель»?
bulgarian: This game is riveting, Eiland. You said it's called Lords of the Land?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/1
english: Apparently this game is outlawed in seven countries, four provinces and two city-states. It has a storied history of turning neighbor against neighbor.
french: Apparemment, ce jeu est interdit dans sept pays, quatre provinces et deux cités-États. Il paraît qu'il sèmerait la discorde entre voisins.
russian: Оказывается, эта игра запрещена в семи странах, четырёх провинциях и двух вольных городах. Она приобрела дурную славу как источник вражды между соседями.
bulgarian: Apparently this game is outlawed in seven countries, four provinces and two city-states. It has a storied history of turning neighbor against neighbor.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/10
english: This has been simply fascinating. I wonder if I might take the game home with me?
french: C'est vraiment fascinant... Dites, je peux prendre le jeu chez moi pour la semaine ?
russian: Это просто завораживающий опыт. Никто не против, если я заберу эту игру домой?
bulgarian: This has been simply fascinating. I wonder if I might take the game home with me?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/11
english: I'd love to study it.
french: J'aimerais l'étudier de plus près.
russian: Я бы хотела её изучить.
bulgarian: I'd love to study it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/2
english: Of course, we live in more civilized times, so no need to let that ruin the fun!
french: Mais nous vivons en des temps plus civilisés maintenant, alors continuons à nous amuser !
russian: Разумеется, мы живём в более цивилизованный век, так что это не помешает нам весело провести время.
bulgarian: Of course, we live in more civilized times, so no need to let that ruin the fun!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/3
english: Fun? FUN? You think the woodworker's district burning down in the last game was fun?
french: À nous amuser ? Tu as trouvé ça drôle d'incendier le quartier des menuisiers lors de la dernière partie ?
russian: Весело? ВЕСЕЛО? По-твоему, пожар в квартале резчиков по дереву на прошлой игре — это весело?
bulgarian: Fun? FUN? You think the woodworker's district burning down in the last game was fun?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/4
english: It only burned down because you were courting the reformed thieves guild in hopes of swindling them out of their property.
french: Il a brûlé parce que tu t'intéressais de près à la guilde des voleurs repentis pour les virer de chez eux.
russian: Пожар был только потому, что ты заигрывал с реформированной гильдией воров, надеясь обманом заполучить их здания.
bulgarian: It only burned down because you were courting the reformed thieves guild in hopes of swindling them out of their property.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/5
english: Instead, they came after you! For revenge!
french: Finalement, ils se sont retournés contre toi pour se venger !
russian: А вместо этого они пришли за тобой! Чтобы отомстить!
bulgarian: Instead, they came after you! For revenge!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/6
english: We don't take kindly to being tricked, Dad. You should have taken the deal. It was an honest offer.
french: On n'a pas apprécié que tu veuilles nous rouler dans la farine, papa. Tu aurais dû accepter le marché. C'était une offre plus que raisonnable.
russian: Мы не потерпим обмана, папа. Тебе надо было соглашаться на сделку. Это было честное предложение.
bulgarian: We don't take kindly to being tricked, Dad. You should have taken the deal. It was an honest offer.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/7
english: Actually, it was a bit outrageous as offers go... you overvalued that real estate at least twice over.
french: Si je puis me permettre, ta proposition était un peu exagérée.... Ton estimation était au moins le double des prix du marché.
russian: Вообще-то, это было довольно возмутительное предложение... Вы переоценили вашу недвижимость как минимум вдвое.
bulgarian: Actually, it was a bit outrageous as offers go... you overvalued that real estate at least twice over.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/8
english: We're a reformed thieves guild, Eiland... not fools.
french: On est une guilde de voleurs repentis, Eiland... Pas des imbéciles.
russian: Мы реформированная гильдия воров, Эйланд... А не какие-то дурачки.
bulgarian: We're a reformed thieves guild, Eiland... not fools.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/9
english: Do you take us for fools, Eiland?
french: Tu nous prends pour des imbéciles, Eiland ?
russian: Или, по-твоему, мы дурачки, Эйланд?
bulgarian: Do you take us for fools, Eiland?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/init
english: I uncovered some interesting facts about Lords of the Land in the past week!
french: J'ai découvert plusieurs anecdotes intéressantes sur Seigneurs des terres cette semaine !
russian: За эту неделю я узнал кое-какие любопытные факты про «Владык земель»!
bulgarian: I uncovered some interesting facts about Lords of the Land in the past week!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/1
english: It's true! Reina really outdid herself. And Eiland, this tea is so lovely and floral! Thank you for sharing it with us.
french: Oui ! Reina s'est surpassée. Et Eiland, ce thé est si délicat et floral ! Merci de nous en faire profiter.
russian: Это правда! Рейна превзошла саму себя. Кстати, Эйланд, твой чай такой приятно цветочный. Спасибо, что угостил.
bulgarian: It's true! Reina really outdid herself. And Eiland, this tea is so lovely and floral! Thank you for sharing it with us.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/2
english: Of course! Good things are meant to be shared.
french: Oh, mais de rien ! Les bonnes choses sont faites pour être partagées.
russian: Ну разумеется! Хорошими вещами всегда нужно делиться.
bulgarian: Of course! Good things are meant to be shared.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/3
english: Weren't we playing a board game, though?
french: Mais dites, nous n'étions pas censés jouer à un jeu de société ?
russian: Но мне казалось, у нас была настольная игра?
bulgarian: Weren't we playing a board game, though?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/4
english: That's right! Lords of the Land. Didn't Valen take it home last time?
french: Mais oui ! Aux Seigneurs des terres. Valen l'a emporté chez elle la dernière fois, non ?
russian: Точно! «Владыки земель». Кажется, Вален в прошлый раз забрала её домой?
bulgarian: That's right! Lords of the Land. Didn't Valen take it home last time?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/5
english: I threw it in the river.
french: Et je l'ai jeté dans la rivière.
russian: Я выбросила её в реку.
bulgarian: I threw it in the river.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/6
english: You threw a historical artifact... in the river?
french: Tu as jeté un artéfact historique... dans la rivière ?
russian: Ты выбросила исторический артефакт... в реку?
bulgarian: You threw a historical artifact... in the river?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/7
english: It seemed the best place for it. And look at us! We're all getting along quite nicely.
french: C'était sa place. Et regardez le résultat ! Tout le monde s'entend bien, comme avant.
russian: Мне показалось, что это подходящее для такой игры. И смотрите! Мы сразу отлично ладим друг с другом.
bulgarian: It seemed the best place for it. And look at us! We're all getting along quite nicely.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/8
english: But Valen... what happens when it washes up in the next town over?
french: Mais Valen... Que se passera-t-il s'il échoue entre les mains d'autres personnes ?
russian: Но, Вален... представляешь, что будет в том городе, где её выбросит на берег?
bulgarian: But Valen... what happens when it washes up in the next town over?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/9
english: It'll tear that village apart!
french: Ils s'entretueront !
russian: Вся деревня перессорится!
bulgarian: It'll tear that village apart!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/init
english: These shortcakes are delicious, Celine.
french: Ces petits sablés sont délicieux, Céline.
russian: Пирожные — просто объедение, Селин.
bulgarian: These shortcakes are delicious, Celine.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/1
english: Now, let's introduce our first book! Terithia picked Tales of the Sea, a collection of fishy folktales. Tell me about your favorite story!
french: Bien, c'est le moment de présenter notre premier livre ! Terithia a choisi « Les Contes des mers », un recueil d'histoires populaires sur les océans. Dis-nous qu'elle est ta préférée !
russian: Давайте же представим нашу первую книгу! Теризия выбрала «Морские истории», сборник водянистых народных сказок. Расскажите, какая вам понравилась больше всего!
bulgarian: Now, let's introduce our first book! Terithia picked Tales of the Sea, a collection of fishy folktales. Tell me about your favorite story!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/2
english: I quite liked the Ballad of the Sea Cucumber. For a story with such an adorable premise, the sense of melancholy at the close is what made it stick out in my mind.
french: J'aime beaucoup « La Ballade du concombre de mer ». L'idée de départ est adorable, mais c'est le sentiment de mélancolie à la fin qui m'a marquée.
russian: Мне понравилась «Баллада о морском огурце». Учитывая её невинную завязку, чувство меланхолии в финале для меня выделяет её на фоне остальных.
bulgarian: I quite liked the Ballad of the Sea Cucumber. For a story with such an adorable premise, the sense of melancholy at the close is what made it stick out in my mind.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/3
english: Oh yeah, I liked that one. My favorite was the one about the three pirates. I had no idea who was going to end up captain in the end!
french: Oh oui, je l'ai beaucoup aimée. Ma préférée reste celle des trois pirates. Jusqu'à la fin, je me suis demandé qui allait devenir capitaine !
russian: О да, мне она тоже понравилась. Но моя любимая — про трёх пиратов. До самого конца не мог догадаться, кто из них станет капитаном!
bulgarian: Oh yeah, I liked that one. My favorite was the one about the three pirates. I had no idea who was going to end up captain in the end!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/4
english: To be frank, I've been on ships like that.
french: Si vous voulez tout savoir, j'ai déjà navigué sur des bateaux de ce genre.
russian: Честно говоря, мне приходилось бывать на таких кораблях.
bulgarian: To be frank, I've been on ships like that.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/5
english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/6
english: I was partial to the Siren's Song story! I could relate, I'm not immune to a charming face and a pretty ditty!
french: Moi, j'ai beaucoup aimé « Le Chant de la sirène » ! Car un beau visage et un joli brin de voix ne m'ont jamais laissé indifférent !
russian: Меня затронула «Песня сирены»! Могу понять их чувства, невозможно противостоять соблазну прелестного личика и милой песенки!
bulgarian: I was partial to the Siren's Song story! I could relate, I'm not immune to a charming face and a pretty ditty!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/7
english: You'd walk right into the ocean, I suspect.
french: Tu plongerais directement dans l'océan en l'entendant, alors.
russian: Подозреваю, ты бы зашагал прямиком в океан.
bulgarian: You'd walk right into the ocean, I suspect.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/8
english: Lucky for me I'm such a strong swimmer!
french: Heureusement pour moi que je sais très bien nager !
russian: Мне повезло, что я такой хороший пловец!
bulgarian: Lucky for me I'm such a strong swimmer!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/init
english: Oh, it is so exciting to welcome you to book club! I ran one in the Capital, too... I find discussion helps stimulate my mind as I formulate my memoirs!
french: Je suis si heureuse de ce club de lecture ! J'en avais aussi créé un à la capitale... Ces discussions stimulantes me permettent de rédiger mes mémoires !
russian: Ох, с волнением приветствую вас в книжном клубе! Я уже проводила такой в столице... Я знаю, что обсуждения помогают мне размять ум и яснее формулировать свои мемуары.
bulgarian: Oh, it is so exciting to welcome you to book club! I ran one in the Capital, too... I find discussion helps stimulate my mind as I formulate my memoirs!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/1
english: I've been dying to talk about this book all week! I started reading right after our last session, and I couldn't put it down! The twists! The turns!
french: Ça fait une semaine que je veux vous en parler ! Je l'ai commencé après notre dernière réunion et je n'ai pas pu m'arrêter ! Tous ces rebondissements, ce suspense !
russian: Всю неделю хочу обсудить эту книгу! Я начала читать сразу после нашей прошлой встречи и не могла оторваться! Какие неожиданные повороты!
bulgarian: I've been dying to talk about this book all week! I started reading right after our last session, and I couldn't put it down! The twists! The turns!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/2
english: I love a closed room mystery, and setting it on a ship was so cool.
french: J'adore les huis clos et, là, j'ai beaucoup aimé que ça se passe sur un bateau.
russian: Я люблю убийства в закрытой комнате, и мне очень понравился выбор корабля как места действия.
bulgarian: I love a closed room mystery, and setting it on a ship was so cool.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/3
english: When they said the first murder happened on the deck, where it was impossible to hide... I was captivated. I started keeping a journal!
french: Quand ils ont dit que le premier meurtre avait eu lieu sur le pont alors qu'il était impossible de s'y cacher... je suis rentré dedans. J'ai même commencé à tenir un journal !
russian: Когда они сказали, что первое убийство произошло на палубе, где негде спрятаться... Это захватило моё внимание. Я стал вести заметки!
bulgarian: When they said the first murder happened on the deck, where it was impossible to hide... I was captivated. I started keeping a journal!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/4
english: Then Ryis and I got to talking about it, and we started pinning notes to the wall in my room. I woke up and went to sleep staring at that thing!
french: Ensuite, Ryis et moi, on en a parlé. On a commencé à épingler des notes sur un mur de ma chambre. Au réveil et au coucher, je les avais sous le nez !
russian: Затем мы с Ризом стали их обсуждать и вешать записи на стену в моей комнате. Я засыпал и просыпался, глядя на них!
bulgarian: Then Ryis and I got to talking about it, and we started pinning notes to the wall in my room. I woke up and went to sleep staring at that thing!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/5
english: I was a man possessed! I couldn't figure it out!
french: C'était devenu une obsession ! Je ne trouvais pas la solution !
russian: Я был как одержимый! Никак не мог разгадать!
bulgarian: I was a man possessed! I couldn't figure it out!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/6
english: The writer also had all the little nautical details down pat. The absentee pennant, the fake murder weapon hidden in the bilge, the landlubber knots being a clue...
french: L'auteur a vraiment utilisé l'univers marin à fond. Le pavillon d'absence, la fausse arme du crime cachée en fond de cale, les nœuds indignes d'un marin pour indice...
russian: А ещё писатель хорошо разбирается во флотских тонкостях. Отсутствие командирского вымпела, ложное орудие убийства в трюме, сухопутные узлы в качестве улик...
bulgarian: The writer also had all the little nautical details down pat. The absentee pennant, the fake murder weapon hidden in the bilge, the landlubber knots being a clue...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/7
english: It was very convincing!
french: C'était très convaincant !
russian: Всё это было очень убедительно!
bulgarian: It was very convincing!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/8
english: And who would have thought the butler was the murderer? Not me! But it all made sense...

english: Yes... unique... rarely have I seen a book written with such, ah... deliberate precision.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/2
english: But the diagrams! Illustrations were a welcome addition.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/3
english: I thought the author's note at the end was rather romantic. In his heart, he dedicated that building to his wife.
french: J'ai trouvé le mot de l'auteur à la toute fin très romantique. Dans son cœur, il dédiait le bâtiment à sa femme bien-aimée.

bulgarian: I thought the author's note at the end was rather romantic. In his heart, he dedicated that building to his wife.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/4
english: Even if he was rather dry about it.
french: Même s'il est resté plutôt laconique à ce sujet.
russian: Пускай и сообщил об этом довольно сухо.
bulgarian: Even if he was rather dry about it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/5
english: See, Ryis? What'd I tell you? We spent a whole summer bonding over that book, and now they're appreciating it too!
french: Tu vois, Ryis ? Je te l'avais dit. Tout l'été, ce livre nous a permis de tisser du lien, et maintenant, ils l'apprécient aussi !

bulgarian: See, Ryis? What'd I tell you? We spent a whole summer bonding over that book, and now they're appreciating it too!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/6
english: Uncle, it's a technical manual for reconstructing a wooden cathedral... I don't think this is the kind of book Elsie was talking about. Sorry guys, I tried to talk him out of it.
french: Oncle Landen, c'est un traité sur la reconstruction d'une cathédrale en bois... Elsie ne parlait pas de ce genre de livres. Désolé, les amis, j'ai essayé de l'en dissuader.
russian: Дядя, это техническое руководство по реконструкции деревянного собора... Я думаю, Элси имела в виду не такие книги. Простите, ребята, я пытался его отговорить.
bulgarian: Uncle, it's a technical manual for reconstructing a wooden cathedral... I don't think this is the kind of book Elsie was talking about. Sorry guys, I tried to talk him out of it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/7
english: I did enjoy rereading it, though...
french: Moi, en tout cas, j'ai bien aimé le relire...
russian: Хотя мне понравилось перечитывать...
bulgarian: I did enjoy rereading it, though...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/init
english: So, ah... Landen and Ryis' choice of book was a bit unique, don't ya think?
french: Alors, euh... j'ai trouvé le livre choisi par Landen et Ryis un peu déconcertant, non ?
russian: Так, э-э... Ланден и Риз выбрали довольно специфическую книгу, да
bulgarian: So, ah... Landen and Ryis' choice of book was a bit unique, don't ya think?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/1
english: The Rise and Fall of House Amore. What a story!
french: « Grandeur et décadence de la Maison Amore ». Quelle saga !
russian: «Взлёт и падение дома Амур». Вот это история!
bulgarian: The Rise and Fall of House Amore. What a story!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/10
english: Would it be too forward to ask for mine to be signed?
french: Oserais-je vous demander de me dédicacer le mien ?
russian: Не слишком нахально будет попросить его подписать?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/2
english: I'll say! This is what book club is all about! Though I don't know how I feel about Ryis reading about all that.
french: Tout à fait ! C'est ça qu'on aime au club de lecture ! Même si je ne suis pas sûr que ce soit pour Ryis.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/3
english: What are you even talking about? It was hardly lurid.
french: Mais qu'est-ce que tu racontes ? Il n'y a rien d'olé olé.
russian: О чём ты вообще, дядя? Там не было ничего откровенного.
bulgarian: What are you even talking about? It was hardly lurid.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/4
english: Listen to you! In my day that chapter twelve hand-holding scene would have meant a content warning on the cover!
french: Ben voyons ! À mon époque, quand ils se tiennent la main au chapitre douze, ça aurait valu un avertissement sur la première de couverture !
russian: Ишь какой! В моё время за сцену в двенадцатой главе, где они держатся за руки, ставили предупреждение на обложке.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/5
english: Anyway! I love a good love triangle. And this one was so good. I really didn't know which way the princess would go!
french: Bref ! J'adore les triangles amoureux, et celui-ci était vraiment prenant. Jusqu'au bout, je me suis demandé qui la princesse allait choisir !
russian: Так вот: я люблю хорошие любовные треугольники. А этот был очень хорош. Я до самого конца не мог понять, кого предпочтёт принцесса.
bulgarian: Anyway! I love a good love triangle. And this one was so good. I really didn't know which way the princess would go!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/6
english: The maelstrom of feelings I had at the end! The joy of love realized! The heart, crushed to pieces!
french: J'ai été pris dans un tourbillon d'émotions à la fin ! Le bonheur d'un amour comblé et l'horreur d'un cœur en morceaux !
russian: Какой водоворот эмоций я испытал в конце! Счастье осуществлённой любви! И сердце, разбитое вдребезги!
bulgarian: The maelstrom of feelings I had at the end! The joy of love realized! The heart, crushed to pieces!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/7
english: Aw, you big old softie.
french: Oh, regardez-moi ce grand tendre.
russian: Ах ты большой старый тюфяк!
bulgarian: Aw, you big old softie.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/8
english: Elsie, aren't you writing a romance novel? Let's have a special session when it's ready!
french: Elsie, vous n'étiez pas en train d'écrire un roman d'amour ? Il faudra organiser une lecture quand il sera fini !
russian: Элси, ты, кажется, пишешь романтическую повесть? Давайте устроим специальное собрание, когда она выйдет!
bulgarian: Elsie, aren't you writing a romance novel? Let's have a special session when it's ready!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/9
english: I'm actually writing my memoirs, so there are many romances to speak of. I'm so delighted you're interested! When I'm done, you'll all get a free copy!
french: Je rédige mes mémoires, alors ce ne sont pas les histoires d'amour qui manquent. Je suis ravie que ça vous intéresse ! Vous aurez tous droit à un exemplaire quand j'aurai terminé !
russian: Вообще-то, я пишу мемуары, так что там много любопытных романов. Мне так приятно, что вы заинтересовались! Когда я закончу, вам всем полагается бесплатный экземпляр!
bulgarian: I'm actually writing my memoirs, so there are many romances to speak of. I'm so delighted you're interested! When I'm done, you'll all get a free copy!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_4/book_club_4/init
english: I'm not one for lovey-dovey stuff, but the book you picked was a real shipsinker, Elsie!
french: Je n'aime pas trop les romans à l'eau de rose, mais le livre que vous avez choisi m'a fait chavirer, Elsie !
russian: Обычно я не читаю про всякую любовь-морковь, но от твоей книги у меня душа пошла под киль, Элси!
bulgarian: I'm not one for lovey-dovey stuff, but the book you picked was a real shipsinker, Elsie!

english: Isn't that right, Dragonguard recruits?
french: Pas vrai, jeunes recrues de la Garde des dragons ?
russian: Верно, новобранцы Драконьей стражи?
bulgarian: Isn't that right, Dragonguard recruits?

english: Treasure?
french: Un trésor ?
russian: Сокровище?
bulgarian: Treasure?

english: Treasure?
french: Un trésor ?
russian: Сокровище?
bulgarian: Treasure?

english: Hmm. You guys have a long way to go before you're ready to hear about treasure beyond your wildest dreams.
french: Mmm. Vous avez encore des progrès à faire avant d'être prêts à entendre parler d'un trésor incroyable.
russian: Хмм. Вам, ребята, ещё надо поучиться, вы пока не готовы к богатствам, о которых только мечтать.
bulgarian: Hmm. You guys have a long way to go before you're ready to hear about treasure beyond your wildest dreams.

english: Now, dragonguard recruits... move out!
french: À présent, nouvelles recrues de la Garde des dragons... rompez !
russian: Итак, новобранцы Драконьей стражи... Вперёд!
bulgarian: Now, dragonguard recruits... move out!

english: Actually, I was just going to my room.
french: Euh, je voulais juste aller dans ma chambre.
russian: Вообще-то, я просто шёл в свою комнату.
bulgarian: Actually, I was just going to my room.

english: I had a question for Adeline...
french: Moi, je voulais poser une question à Adeline...
russian: У меня был вопрос к Аделине...
bulgarian: I had a question for Adeline...

english: It's more like I'm here to recruit the Dragonguard?
french: Et moi, je m'occupe de recruter pour la Garde des dragons, c'est ça ?
russian: Скорее, это я пришла завербовать Драконью стражу.
bulgarian: It's more like I'm here to recruit the Dragonguard?

english: For new duties! Like litter pickup!
french: Pour de nouvelles missions ! Le ramassage d'ordures par exemple !
russian: На новые задачи! Например, уборку мусора!
bulgarian: For new duties! Like litter pickup!

english: Don't worry, Dell. I'm here because I totally believe in the dragonguys!
french: Ne t'inquiète pas, Dell. Moi, je suis à fond avec les dragons.
russian: Не переживай, Делл. Я пришёл, потому что я правда верю в Драконьих ребят.
bulgarian: Don't worry, Dell. I'm here because I totally believe in the dragonguys!

english: Boy oh boy... I can't say I'm impressed with the quality of recruits these days.
french: Bon... On n'est pas gâtés avec ces nouvelles recrues, moi je vous le dis.
russian: Ну и ну... Не скажу, что я впечатлена нынешней подготовкой новобранцев.
bulgarian: Boy oh boy... I can't say I'm impressed with the quality of recruits these days.

english: I guess Olric will be the only one to hear about the treasure I found.
french: Tant pis, Olric sera le seul à en savoir plus sur le trésor que j'ai trouvé.
russian: Выходит, только Ольрик узнает про сокровище, которое я нашла.
bulgarian: I guess Olric will be the only one to hear about the treasure I found.

english: Treasure?
french: Un trésor ?
russian: Сокровище?
bulgarian: Treasure?

english: While everyone down there is playing, we're up here doing the real work.
french: Pendant que tout le monde s'amuse en bas, c'est nous qui faisons tout le boulot ici.
russian: Пока все остальные играют, мы тут делаем настоящую работу.
bulgarian: While everyone down there is playing, we're up here doing the real work.

english: Nora is Dell's mother... it's possible, I suppose.
french: Étant donné que Dell a Nora pour mère, tout est possible.
russian: Ведь Делл — дочь Норы... Так что полагаю, такое возможно.
bulgarian: Nora is Dell's mother... it's possible, I suppose.

english: Dell mentioned Dragonguard treasure the other day... do you suppose the Dragonguard is financially solvent?
french: Dell a dit que la Garde des dragons avait un trésor l'autre jour... Tu crois qu'ils ont beaucoup de fonds ?
russian: Делл на днях упоминала сокровище Драконьей стражи... Ты полагаешь, они могут обладать финансовой стабильностью?
bulgarian: Dell mentioned Dragonguard treasure the other day... do you suppose the Dragonguard is financially solvent?

english: My mind is racing!
french: J'ai plein d'idées !
russian: Воображение у меня разыгралось!
bulgarian: My mind is racing!

english: What could Dell's treasure be? Gems? A cache of tesserae? Ancient coins?
french: Que peut contenir le trésor de Dell ? Des gemmes ? Des tesserae ? Des pièces d'époque ?
russian: Какое может быть у Делл сокровище? Драгоценности? Тайник тессер? Древние монеты?
bulgarian: What could Dell's treasure be? Gems? A cache of tesserae? Ancient coins?

english: Do you know what it is?
french: Mais tu sais ce que c'est ?
russian: А ты, случайно, не знаешь?
bulgarian: Do you know what it is?

english: It's not like I even want to know what Dell's treasure is...
french: Je n'en ai pas grand-chose à faire du trésor de Dell...
russian: Не то чтобы я вообще хотела знать, что у Делл за сокровище...
bulgarian: It's not like I even want to know what Dell's treasure is...

english: I bet it's a cool rock!
french: Je parie que c'est une super belle pierre !
russian: Спорим, это какой-то крутой камень!
bulgarian: I bet it's a cool rock!

english: What do you think Dell's treasure is?
french: C'est quoi, le trésor de Dell, à ton avis ?
russian: Как думаешь, что у Делл за сокровище?
bulgarian: What do you think Dell's treasure is?

english: I can't just tell you, Miss Juniper. You have to prove yourselves!
french: Je ne peux pas vous le dire, madame Juniper. Vous êtes obligée de faire vos preuves avant !
russian: Я не могу вам сказать, мисс Джунипер. Вам нужно доказать свою верность!
bulgarian: I can't just tell you, Miss Juniper. You have to prove yourselves!

english: It's the Dragonguard's job to help the town. So what have you done for Mistria this week?
french: La mission de la Garde des dragons est de venir en aide à la ville. Alors, qu'avez-vous fait pour Mistria cette semaine ?
russian: Цель Драконьей стражи — помогать городу. Что вы сделали для Мистрии за эту неделю?
bulgarian: It's the Dragonguard's job to help the town. So what have you done for Mistria this week?

english: Well, I coordinated the town's postings for the request board.
french: Eh bien, j'ai géré la publication des annonces sur le panneau des requêtes.
russian: Ну, я занималась организацией объявлений на доске прошений.
bulgarian: Well, I coordinated the town's postings for the request board.

english: I sourced and imported a variety of supplies that are otherwise difficult to obtain in Mistria.
french: Moi, je suis allé chercher ailleurs tout un tas d'articles difficiles à se procurer à Mistria.
russian: Я добыл и импортировал разнообразные припасы, которые сложно найти в Мистрии иным способом.
bulgarian: I sourced and imported a variety of supplies that are otherwise difficult to obtain in Mistria.

english: I trained extra hard this week!
french: Et moi, je me suis entraîné comme jamais !
russian: Я на этой неделе тренировался сильнее обычного!
bulgarian: I trained extra hard this week!

english: I... heroically ordered the most expensive bottle of wine at the Inn! Thereby contributing to the great wheel of the Mistrian economy!
french: Moi... Je n'ai pas hésité à commander la bouteille de vin la plus chère de l'auberge ! J'ai donc contribué massivement à l'économie mistrienne !
russian: Я... Героически заказала самое дорогое вино в трактире! Так я помогаю вращать колёса мистрийской экономики!
bulgarian: I... heroically ordered the most expensive bottle of wine at the Inn! Thereby contributing to the great wheel of the Mistrian economy!

english: You're really holding the other recruits back here, Miss Juniper. But I guess we can decide what to do with the treasure... next week.
french: Vous avez surpassé les autres nouvelles recrues, madame Juniper. Enfin, on verra ce qu'on doit faire du trésor... la semaine prochaine.
russian: Вы заметно ослабляете общий уровень новобранцев, мисс Джунипер. Но, я думаю, мы сможем договориться касательно сокровищ... на следующей неделе.
bulgarian: You're really holding the other recruits back here, Miss Juniper. But I guess we can decide what to do with the treasure... next week.

english: Okay, Dell. It's time we had a talk, grown-up to kid. What's the Dragonguard's treasure?
french: Bon, Dell. Il est temps qu'on parle. C'est quoi, le trésor de la Garde des dragons ?
russian: Так, Делл. Настало время нам поговорить как взрослые с ребёнком. Что за сокровище у Драконьей стражи?
bulgarian: Okay, Dell. It's time we had a talk, grown-up to kid. What's the Dragonguard's treasure?

english: Hmm... I'll allow it.
french: Mmm... Bon, d'accord.
russian: Хмм... Ладно, я разрешаю.
bulgarian: Hmm... I'll allow it.

english: Wow, these are really cool ideas!
french: Hé, c'est des super idées !
russian: Ух ты, это всё очень крутые идеи!
bulgarian: Wow, these are really cool ideas!

english: This is going to be great! Once we find it!
french: Ce sera génial ! Une fois qu'on l'aura trouvé !
russian: Всё будет замечательно! Когда мы его найдём!
bulgarian: This is going to be great! Once we find it!

english: Find it?
french: Trouvé ?
russian: Найдём?
bulgarian: Find it?

english: I forgot where I buried it! And as the new recruits, you guys have to find it and dig it up.
french: J'ai oublié où je l'ai enterré ! Et en tant que nouvelles recrues, votre mission est de le retrouver et de le récupérer.
russian: Я забыла, где я его закопала! И вы как новобранцы обязаны найти его и откопать.
bulgarian: I forgot where I buried it! And as the new recruits, you guys have to find it and dig it up.

english: I see... Well.
french: Ah, je vois...
russian: Ага... Понятно.
bulgarian: I see... Well.

english: Maybe we can borrow shovels from Eiland...
french: Dans ce cas, peut-être qu'Eiland va pouvoir nous prêter des pelles...
russian: Может, одолжим лопаты у Эйланда...
bulgarian: Maybe we can borrow shovels from Eiland...

english: Let's use the treasure to invest towards Mistria's development. Putting the resources into something the whole town can enjoy would make it everyone's treasure!
french: Servons-nous du trésor pour aider au développement de Mistria. De cette manière, toute la ville en profitera et le trésor sera pour tout le monde !
russian: Давайте используем сокровище на развитие Мистрии. Если ресурсы использовать на что-то, полезное всему городу, то сокровище будет принадлежать всем!
bulgarian: Let's use the treasure to invest towards Mistria's development. Putting the resources into something the whole town can enjoy would make it everyone's treasure!

english: But Adeline, it's not everyone's treasure, it's the Dragonguard's treasure.
french: Mais Adeline, ce n'est pas le trésor de tout le monde. C'est celui de la Garde des dragons.
russian: Но, Аделина, сокровище принадлежит не всем, а Драконьей страже.
bulgarian: But Adeline, it's not everyone's treasure, it's the Dragonguard's treasure.

english: I propose that the treasure be invested into the Dragonguard's future. A small fortune today could become a vast resource tomorrow.
french: Je propose d'investir le trésor dans l'avenir de la Garde des dragons. Une somme non négligeable aujourd'hui pourrait devenir une véritable fortune demain.
russian: Я предлагаю вложить сокровище в будущее Драконьей стражи. Небольшой вклад сегодня принесёт большие плоды завтра.
bulgarian: I propose that the treasure be invested into the Dragonguard's future. A small fortune today could become a vast resource tomorrow.

english: With the right guidance from yours truly, of course.
french: Si vous suivez mes conseils, évidemment.
russian: Под чутким руководством вашего покорного, разумеется.
