russian: Но она не очень загадочная!
bulgarian: But she's not very mysterious!

english: Unless that's what she wants us to think...
french: À moins que ce ne soit ce qu'elle veut nous faire croire...
russian: Если, конечно, она не хочет, чтобы мы так думали...
bulgarian: Unless that's what she wants us to think...

english: We're doing a special version of charades this week, [Ari]!
french: Ce soir, on joue à une version différente des mimes, [Ari] !
russian: На этой неделе у нас особенная угадайка, [Ari]!
bulgarian: We're doing a special version of charades this week, [Ari]!

english: Our inaugural dish is a local favorite! Mistrian =Berries and Cream=!
french: Commençons par un dessert typique, les =baies sauvages à la chantilly= de Mistria !
russian: Наше открывающее блюдо — изюминка местной кухни. Мистрийские =ягоды со сливками=!
bulgarian: Our inaugural dish is a local favorite! Mistrian =Berries and Cream=!

english: I can tell you, I've traveled far and wide, and I've never seen fluffier cream than this!
french: J'en ai parcouru du pays et je peux vous dire que c'est la première fois que je vois une chantilly aussi épaisse que celle-ci !
russian: Точно тебе говорю, я бывала в дальних странах, но нигде не видела таких пышных сливок!
bulgarian: I can tell you, I've traveled far and wide, and I've never seen fluffier cream than this!

english: And the berries! That zing! Did you forage these yourself, Hayden?
french: Et les baies sauvages sont tellement bonnes ! C'est toi qui les as cueillies, Hayden ?
russian: А какие ягоды! Такой вкус! Ты сам их собирал, Хейден?
bulgarian: And the berries! That zing! Did you forage these yourself, Hayden?

english: Sure did! With a helping hand... er, wing from Henrietta! So what do you think, [Ari]? Pretty good, right?
french: Évidemment ! Avec un petit coup de main, euh... d'aile d'Henrietta ! Alors, tu en penses quoi, [Ari] ? Tu trouves ça bon ?
russian: Конечно! Но с рукой помощи... ээ, крылом помощи от Генриетты! Ну как тебе, [Ari]? Неплохо, да?
bulgarian: Sure did! With a helping hand... er, wing from Henrietta! So what do you think, [Ari]? Pretty good, right?

english: It's SO good!
french: Délicieux !
russian: Они ТАКИЕ вкусные!
bulgarian: It's SO good!

english: Is this one of Mistria's signature desserts?
french: C'est une spécialité de Mistria ?
russian: Это один из фирменных мистрийских десертов?
bulgarian: Is this one of Mistria's signature desserts?

english: Even I have to admit it's pretty good.
french: Même moi, j'avoue que c'est bon.
russian: Даже я вынужден признать, что они вкусные.
bulgarian: Even I have to admit it's pretty good.

english: I'd say so.
french: Il faut croire.
russian: Я думаю, да.
bulgarian: I'd say so.

english: Speaking of which, where'd the funding for this dessert club come from?
french: Au fait, d'où vient l'argent pour financer ce club des desserts ?
russian: Кстати, а кто выделил средства на этот клуб десертов?
bulgarian: Speaking of which, where'd the funding for this dessert club come from?

english: We have a mysterious benefactor! One who would prefer to remain anonymous.
french: D'un mécène anonyme ! Et qui préfère le rester.
russian: У нас есть таинственный спонсор! Он предпочитает оставаться анонимным.
bulgarian: We have a mysterious benefactor! One who would prefer to remain anonymous.

english: More berries, I say! More cream!
french: Je veux bien que tu me resserves, s'il te plaît !
russian: Я считаю, надо больше ягод! И больше сливок!
bulgarian: More berries, I say! More cream!

english: Oh, I am so excited for this! Welcome everyone! We'll be indulging in a new dessert every week.
french: Oh là là, je suis surexcitée ! Bienvenue à tous ! Chaque semaine, nous proposerons un nouveau dessert.
russian: Ох, я так взволнована! Привет всем! Каждую неделю мы будем пробовать новый десерт.
bulgarian: Oh, I am so excited for this! Welcome everyone! We'll be indulging in a new dessert every week.

english: Oh... what a unique texture! The cake is fluffy and light, pierced by the sharpness of the fruit!
french: Oh... Quelle texture unique ! Le gâteau est moelleux et léger, sublimé par l'intensité du fruit !
russian: О... Какая необычная консистенция! Пышный и лёгкий торт пронизывает резкий вкус ягод!
bulgarian: Oh... what a unique texture! The cake is fluffy and light, pierced by the sharpness of the fruit!

english: Oh, I am a fan of this one! The fruit is somehow sweet and savory. I wouldn't mind making a jam of it.
french: J'adore ce gâteau ! Le fruit est à la fois sucré et salé. Je pourrais essayer d'en faire de la confiture.
russian: Ох, я поклонник этого десерта! Эти ягоды сладкие и пряные одновременно. Из них можно и варенье сделать.
bulgarian: Oh, I am a fan of this one! The fruit is somehow sweet and savory. I wouldn't mind making a jam of it.

english: Would this be better with coffee or sweet tea?
french: Avec quoi est-ce que ça se marierait le mieux, un café ou un thé doux ?
russian: К нему больше подходит кофе или сладкий чай?
bulgarian: Would this be better with coffee or sweet tea?

english: Coffee!
french: Le café !
russian: Кофе!
bulgarian: Coffee!

english: Sweet Tea!
french: Un thé doux !
russian: Сладкий чай!
bulgarian: Sweet Tea!

english: Bitter and sweet always compliment each other, don't they?
french: L'amer et le sucré s'accordent toujours bien, pas vrai ?
russian: Согласна, горечь и сладость всегда сочетаются!
bulgarian: Bitter and sweet always compliment each other, don't they?

english: Just what I was thinking! A perfect afternoon snack.
french: Je suis d'accord ! Ce serait parfait pour le goûter.
russian: Я тоже так думаю! Отличный перекус днём.
bulgarian: Just what I was thinking! A perfect afternoon snack.

english: Did you dry the fruits before baking them in? I like it. A lot more tart than I would have thought.
french: As-tu fait sécher les fruits avant de les incorporer ? J'aime bien. C'est plus acidulé que j'aurais cru.
russian: Ты просушила ягоды перед запеканием? Мне нравится. Вкус более терпкий, чем может показаться.
bulgarian: Did you dry the fruits before baking them in? I like it. A lot more tart than I would have thought.

english: That's right! I was trying to recreate the cake Terithia remembered. She did a good job describing the tastes and textures.
french: Exactement ! J'ai essayé de recréer le gâteau dont se souvenait Terithia. Elle m'a bien décrit le goût et la texture.
russian: Всё верно! Я попыталась воссоздать тот самый торт, который вспомнила Теризия. Ей хорошо удалось описать вкус и текстуру.
bulgarian: That's right! I was trying to recreate the cake Terithia remembered. She did a good job describing the tastes and textures.

english: I hope I can do as good a job describing it to Nora! There's no way my piece is making it home!
french: Il faudra que j'arrive à le décrire aussi bien à Nora, alors ! Parce que je compte pas en laisser une miette !
russian: Надеюсь, у меня получится хорошо описать его для Норы! Потому что этот кусок до дома точно не доживёт!
bulgarian: I hope I can do as good a job describing it to Nora! There's no way my piece is making it home!

english: I was far from Mistria the first time I was offered a slice of $Moon Fruit Cake$, and it's always stuck with me.
french: J'étais loin de Mistria la première fois que j'ai goûté au $gâteau à la lunarine$, mais je m'en souviens encore.
russian: Я была далеко от Мистрии, когда мне впервые предложили $торт из лунных ягод$, и он навсегда мне запомнился.
bulgarian: I was far from Mistria the first time I was offered a slice of $Moon Fruit Cake$, and it's always stuck with me.

english: $Salted Watermelon$!
french: De la $pastèque au sel$ !
russian: $Солёный арбуз$!
bulgarian: $Salted Watermelon$!

english: Oh! Oh! Intriguing!
french: Oh ! Mais ! C'est surprenant !
russian: Ого! Ого! Занимательно!
bulgarian: Oh! Oh! Intriguing!

english: We're all very proud of you, Eiland.
french: Nous sommes tous très fiers de toi, Eiland.
russian: Мы гордимся тобой, Эйланд.
bulgarian: We're all very proud of you, Eiland.

english: He's mad! Salt? In dessert?
french: Ça ne va pas bien ?! Du sel ? Dans un dessert ?
russian: Он с ума сошёл! Соль? В десерте?
bulgarian: He's mad! Salt? In dessert?

english: I've salted fish, but on watermelon? I wonder.
french: On sale le poisson, mais la pastèque ? Vraiment ?!
russian: Я засаливала рыбу, но арбузы? Любопытно.
bulgarian: I've salted fish, but on watermelon? I wonder.

english: Salt makes sweet flavors more balanced, doesn't it?
french: Le sel équilibre le goût sucré, non ?
russian: Соль хорошо балансирует сладкий вкус.
bulgarian: Salt makes sweet flavors more balanced, doesn't it?

english: March is ruining dessert for everyone!
french: March va nous gâcher le dessert !
russian: Март хочет испортить всем десерт!
bulgarian: March is ruining dessert for everyone!

english: That's right, [Ari]! Darcy and I both use salt in most of our baked goods.
french: C'est vrai, [Ari] ! Darcy et moi mettons du sel dans la plupart de nos pâtisseries.
russian: Правильно, [Ari]! Мы с Дарси обе часто используем соль в выпечке.
bulgarian: That's right, [Ari]! Darcy and I both use salt in most of our baked goods.

english: I guess this is what I get for trying something new.
french: Voilà ce que je récolte à vouloir tenter quelque chose de nouveau.
russian: Вот так к тебе относятся, когда предлагаешь новые идеи.
bulgarian: I guess this is what I get for trying something new.

english: We grew up putting salt on our watermelon! According to Valen, both salt and watermelon replenish your electrolytes. Great on a hot summer's day!
french: J'ai grandi en mettant du sel sur la pastèque ! D'après Valen, le sel et la pastèque, c'est bon pour refaire le plein d'électrolytes. C'est l'idéal quand il fait chaud l'été !
russian: А мы с детства солим арбузы! Вален говорит, что и соль и арбуз помогают поддерживать баланс электролитов. То что нужно в жаркий летний день!
bulgarian: We grew up putting salt on our watermelon! According to Valen, both salt and watermelon replenish your electrolytes. Great on a hot summer's day!

english: At first I was with Eiland, but have you tried it?
french: Au début, j'étais de l'avis d'Eiland, mais vous avez goûté ?
russian: Вначале я согласился с Эйландом, но вы сами пробовали?
bulgarian: At first I was with Eiland, but have you tried it?

english: It's so sweet it's making my mustache spin!
french: C'est tellement doux que j'en ai la moustache qui frémit !
russian: Он такой сладкий, что у меня усы завернулись!
bulgarian: It's so sweet it's making my mustache spin!

english: Fine, I'll try it...
french: Bon, d'accord...
russian: Ладно, попробую...
bulgarian: Fine, I'll try it...

english: Listen up! This is the March takeover of the dessert club. This time we're eating something I've been meaning to try...
french: Écoutez tous ! Aujourd'hui, c'est moi qui gère le club des desserts. On va goûter quelque chose qui me fait envie depuis longtemps...
russian: Внимание! Внимание! Клуб десертов захвачен Мартом. На этот раз у нас блюдо, которое я давно хотел попробовать...
bulgarian: Listen up! This is the March takeover of the dessert club. This time we're eating something I've been meaning to try...

english: I can't believe I kept a lid on it! I've been gathering the best of the best ingredients from my farm, so this week we're having...
french: Je n'arrive pas à croire que j'aie réussi à garder le secret ! J'ai utilisé les meilleurs ingrédients de ma ferme, alors cette semaine, on va déguster...
russian: Даже не верится, что у меня получилось! Я отбирал лучшие из лучших ингредиентов с фермы, и сегодня нас ждёт...
bulgarian: I can't believe I kept a lid on it! I've been gathering the best of the best ingredients from my farm, so this week we're having...

english: That's it for dessert club, you guys! Now, I think we'd better leave Eiland alone with the rest of these cookies.
french: Le club des desserts ferme, les amis ! Je pense qu'on ferait mieux de laisser Eiland avec le reste des cookies.
russian: На этом клуб десертов закрывается, ребята! А теперь, думаю, пора оставить Эйланда наедине с остатками печенья.
bulgarian: That's it for dessert club, you guys! Now, I think we'd better leave Eiland alone with the rest of these cookies.

english: It's going to be a disaster.
french: Ça va être un carnage.
russian: Это будет настоящая катастрофа.
bulgarian: It's going to be a disaster.

english: $Golden Cookies$! Fresh out of the oven!
french: Des $cookies dorés$ ! À peine sortis du four !
russian: $Золотое печенье$! Только что из печи!
bulgarian: $Golden Cookies$! Fresh out of the oven!

english: Golden... cookies? The cookies made from only the most perfect of ingredients? The cookies that bring us closest to the divine?
french: Des cookies... dorés ? Des cookies préparés avec les meilleurs ingrédients qui soient ? Des cookies qui flirtent avec le divin ?
russian: Золотое... печенье? То самое, что делается только из лучших ингредиентов? Печенье, приближающее нас ко вкусу небес?
bulgarian: Golden... cookies? The cookies made from only the most perfect of ingredients? The cookies that bring us closest to the divine?

english: Someone catch Eiland, he looks like he's going to faint from happiness!
french: Que quelqu'un rattrape Eiland, on dirait qu'il va s'évanouir de bonheur !
russian: Придержите Эйланда, а то он, кажется, сейчас в обморок упадёт от счастья.
bulgarian: Someone catch Eiland, he looks like he's going to faint from happiness!

english: I'll catch him!
french: Je m'en occupe !
russian: Я ловлю!
bulgarian: I'll catch him!

english: The only thing I'm catching are these cookies!
french: La seule chose que je vais attraper, ce sont ces cookies !
russian: Я лучше буду держать это печенье!
bulgarian: The only thing I'm catching are these cookies!

english: Thank you, and apologies [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari]. Et désolé.
russian: Спасибо и прошу прощения, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, and apologies [Ari].

english: We are of a mind, [Ari]!
french: On est deux, [Ari] !
russian: Ты меня понимаешь, [Ari]!
bulgarian: We are of a mind, [Ari]!

english: One for Dell, and one for me, and one for Dell, and one for me...
french: Un pour Dell et un pour moi, un pour Dell et un pour moi...
russian: Одну для Делл, одну для меня, одну для Делл, одну для меня...
bulgarian: One for Dell, and one for me, and one for Dell, and one for me...

english: Hmm, yeah. It's pretty good, for a cookie.
french: Mmm, c'est vrai qu'ils sont bons, ces cookies.
russian: Хмм, и правда. Для печенья довольно неплохо.
bulgarian: Hmm, yeah. It's pretty good, for a cookie.

english: The richness of top-shelf eggs and butter meld to create a chewiness that melts in your mouth. Superb!
french: La richesse des œufs extrafrais et l'onctuosité du beurre fermier donnent ce moelleux qui fond en bouche. C'est un régal !
russian: Насыщенность отборных яиц и масла создаёт текстуру, которая просто тает во рту. Превосходно!
bulgarian: The richness of top-shelf eggs and butter meld to create a chewiness that melts in your mouth. Superb!

english: I think Hayden's been fit to burst keeping this week's dessert a secret!
french: Hayden a fait de très gros efforts pour ne pas dévoiler le dessert de la semaine !
russian: По-моему, Хейден за эту неделю чуть не лопнул, пытаясь сохранить десерт втайне.
bulgarian: I think Hayden's been fit to burst keeping this week's dessert a secret!

english: Oh no. That's a clown, and I know that look in your eye. You're trying to foist off some junk you found while making it sound like a gift.
french: Oh non. C'est un clown et je connais ce regard, Balor. Tu essaies de me refourguer cette camelote en la faisant passer pour un cadeau.
russian: О, нет. Это же клоун, и я знаю этот твой взгляд. Хочешь впихнуть мне какую-то ерунду, чтобы звучало как подарок.
bulgarian: Oh no. That's a clown, and I know that look in your eye. You're trying to foist off some junk you found while making it sound like a gift.

english: I don't know about that. The frame's not junk, at least. This wood is pretty rare. You'd have to import it at great cost.
french: Pas sûr... Le cadre est de bonne facture, en tout cas. Ce bois est d'ailleurs plutôt rare et coûterait une belle somme.
russian: Не знаю, не знаю. Рама точно добротная. Это редкая древесина. Её импорт обойдётся недёшево.
bulgarian: I don't know about that. The frame's not junk, at least. This wood is pretty rare. You'd have to import it at great cost.

english: The frame is gilded, too! That's extravagant... and a bit odd, for a painting of a clown.
french: Et il est doré ! C'est extravagant... et assez étrange pour un portrait de clown.
russian: И она позолоченная! Весьма экстравагантно... и слегка не к месту, учитывая, что на картине клоун.
bulgarian: The frame is gilded, too! That's extravagant... and a bit odd, for a painting of a clown.

english: The paints are definitely high-quality. See how the red of his nose is still so vibrant? You can't get the ingredients for that kind of vermillion easily.
french: Les peintures sont de qualité. Vous voyez le rouge éclatant sur le nez ? On ne trouve pas facilement les ingrédients nécessaires pour fabriquer ce genre de vermillon.
russian: Краски явно высокого качества. Видите, какой насыщенно-красный нос, несмотря на возраст? Ингредиенты для такого алого красителя непросто найти.
bulgarian: The paints are definitely high-quality. See how the red of his nose is still so vibrant? You can't get the ingredients for that kind of vermillion easily.

english: And look at this, on the margin. I recognize the artist's signature. She was known to be commissioned by the nobility of the era.
french: Et regardez sur le côté. Je reconnais la signature de l'artiste. Elle travaillait sur commande pour la noblesse de l'époque.
russian: И вон, смотрите, в уголке. Я узнаю подпись художницы. В те времена ей часто заказывали картины дворяне.
bulgarian: And look at this, on the margin. I recognize the artist's signature. She was known to be commissioned by the nobility of the era.

english: Huh.
french: Mmm.
russian: Хм.
bulgarian: Huh.

english: Thank you for this priceless painting, Balor.
french: Eh bien, merci pour ce tableau inestimable, Balor.
russian: Спасибо за эту бесценную картину, Балор.
bulgarian: Thank you for this priceless painting, Balor.

english: Now now, let's not be hasty! There's more to this than any of us thought, myself included.
french: Allons, une petite minute ! Ce tableau recèle plus de secrets que nous ne le pensions, moi inclus.
russian: Погодите, давайте не спешить! Эта картина оказалась глубже, чем мы полагали — и я в том числе.
bulgarian: Now now, let's not be hasty! There's more to this than any of us thought, myself included.

english: Let's reconvene this... detective's club next week, so we can properly solve the mystery of the painting!
french: Alors, réunissons-nous à nouveau... la semaine prochaine pour percer le mystère de ce tableau !
russian: Давайте соберём наш... детективный клуб через неделю и окончательно разгадаем тайну этой картины!
bulgarian: Let's reconvene this... detective's club next week, so we can properly solve the mystery of the painting!

english: It's a nice antique painting, isn't it? It's got... character. And it's my gift to you, Nora!
french: C'est un très beau tableau d'époque, non ? Il a... du caractère. Et c'est pour toi, Nora !
russian: Отличная старинная картина, правда? У неё свой... характер. Дарю её тебе, Нора.
bulgarian: It's a nice antique painting, isn't it? It's got... character. And it's my gift to you, Nora!

english: Me either. I asked Eiland to look up the artist, and it turns out she did almost three hundred portraits during her life, mostly for nobility.
french: Moi aussi. J'ai d'ailleurs demandé à Eiland d'en savoir plus sur l'artiste. Il s'avère qu'elle a peint quasiment trois cents portraits dans sa vie, principalement pour la noblesse.
russian: Я тоже. Я попросила Эйланда узнать про художницу, и оказалось, что за свою жизнь она написала более трёхсот портретов, в основном для знати.
bulgarian: Me either. I asked Eiland to look up the artist, and it turns out she did almost three hundred portraits during her life, mostly for nobility.

english: That's... very mysterious.
french: Voilà qui est... très mystérieux.
russian: Это... крайне загадочно.
bulgarian: That's... very mysterious.

english: You don't suppose that this clown is... an immortal creature of the night?
french: Ce clown n'est quand même pas... une créature de la nuit immortelle ?
russian: Вы же не думаете, что этот клоун... бессмертное создание ночи?
bulgarian: You don't suppose that this clown is... an immortal creature of the night?

english: There's something about the subject... underneath all the clown makeup, he almost seems familiar.
french: Ce modèle a quelque chose d'étrange... Sous ce maquillage de clown, il me rappelle quelqu'un.
russian: В изображённой фигуре есть что-то необычное... За клоунским гримом он как будто кажется знакомым.
bulgarian: There's something about the subject... underneath all the clown makeup, he almost seems familiar.

english: I was thinking the same thing... odd, that.
french: C'est marrant... À moi aussi.
russian: Мне тоже так показалось... Это странно.
bulgarian: I was thinking the same thing... odd, that.

english: That's quite unlikely. The painting is over two hundred years old!
french: C'est impossible. Ce tableau a plus de deux cents ans !
russian: Это крайне маловероятно. Ведь картине уже более двухсот лет!
bulgarian: That's quite unlikely. The painting is over two hundred years old!

english: Do you suppose this clown is some kind of... immortal creature of the night?
french: Se pourrait-il que ce clown soit... une créature de la nuit immortelle ?
russian: Вы полагаете, что этот клоун — какое-то... бессмертное создание ночи?
bulgarian: Do you suppose this clown is some kind of... immortal creature of the night?

english: That's Dell talk. Let's not get ahead of ourselves, Celine.
french: On croirait entendre Dell. Ne commençons pas à nous faire des histoires, Céline.
russian: Это что-то в духе Делл. Давай не будем заходить так далеко, Селин.
bulgarian: That's Dell talk. Let's not get ahead of ourselves, Celine.

english: Hm, there's something about this joint in the frame... oh!
french: Mmm, il y a une sorte de joint au niveau du cadre... Oh !
russian: Хм, этот стык на раме выглядит странно... Ой!
bulgarian: Hm, there's something about this joint in the frame... oh!

english: It's a sliding panel! There's a slip of paper inside... I'll read it.
french: C'est un panneau coulissant ! Et il y a un morceau de papier à l'intérieur... Je vais le lire.
russian: Это выдвижная панель! Там внутри клочок бумаги... Сейчас прочитаю.
bulgarian: It's a sliding panel! There's a slip of paper inside... I'll read it.

english: "Do I tell the truth or do I lie? Mine true nature I must deny. If revealed, 'twould gain naught but scorn. My true name is..." It ends there.
french: « Dois-je dire la vérité ou mentir ? Je dois cacher ma vraie nature. Si je la révélais, je ne récolterais que mépris. En réalité, je suis... » Et c'est tout.
russian: «Правду иль ложь скрывает маска? Если лицу сулит огласка... Презреньем буду я измотан. А зовут меня...» — и всё.
bulgarian: "Do I tell the truth or do I lie? Mine true nature I must deny. If revealed, 'twould gain naught but scorn. My true name is..." It ends there.

english: I tell you, this clown is haunting me. After the detective club's observations last week, I haven't been able to stop thinking about this painting.
french: À vrai dire, ce clown m'obsède. Après toutes les observations que les détectives de notre club ont faites la semaine dernière, je n'ai fait que penser à ce portrait.
russian: Я вам точно говорю, этот клоун меня преследует. После открытий детективного клуба на прошлой неделе я не могу не думать об этой картине.
bulgarian: I tell you, this clown is haunting me. After the detective club's observations last week, I haven't been able to stop thinking about this painting.

english: I dug further into the artist, and though she did many portraits, she did most of them for three noble families: The Wainscotts, The Meridians, and The Hawthornes.
french: J'ai creusé encore. Bien que cette artiste ait réalisé de nombreux portraits, ils étaient presque tous pour trois familles : les Wainscott, les Meridian et les Hawthorne.
russian: Я стал глубже исследовать художницу и узнал, что, хоть у неё и много портретов, большинство она делала для трёх дворянских семей: Уэйнскотт, Меридиан и Хоторн.
bulgarian: I dug further into the artist, and though she did many portraits, she did most of them for three noble families: The Wainscotts, The Meridians, and The Hawthornes.

english: I'm familiar with all those names, though the Wainscott name ended when the last daughter of the line married into another house.
french: Ces noms ne me sont pas inconnus, mais la lignée des Wainscott s'est arrêtée quand leur dernière fille a épousé l'héritier d'une autre famille.
russian: Мне знакомы эти семейства, хотя линия Уэйнскоттов прервалась, когда их последняя дочь вышла замуж за другой род.
bulgarian: I'm familiar with all those names, though the Wainscott name ended when the last daughter of the line married into another house.

english: "If revealed, 'twould gain naught but scorn. My true name is..."
french: « Si je la révélais, je ne récolterais que mépris. En réalité, je suis... »
russian: «Презреньем буду я измотан. А зовут меня...»
bulgarian: "If revealed, 'twould gain naught but scorn. My true name is..."

english: Lord Hawthorne!
french: Le seigneur Hawthorne !
russian: Лорд Хоторн!
bulgarian: Lord Hawthorne!

english: Of course! Hawthorne is a famous name in the Capital. You see their faces on campaign posters a few times a year!
french: Mais oui ! Hawthorne est un nom célèbre à la capitale. On voit leurs visages sur les affiches électorales plusieurs fois par an !
russian: Ну конечно! Хоторн — известное столичное семейство. Их лица мелькают на плакатах по несколько раз за год!
bulgarian: Of course! Hawthorne is a famous name in the Capital. You see their faces on campaign posters a few times a year!

english: That explains why the clown looks so familiar! I think we're onto something!
french: Ça explique pourquoi ce clown nous paraissait familier ! Je crois qu'on tient quelque chose !
russian: Это объясняет знакомый вид клоуна! Кажется, мы на правильном пути!
bulgarian: That explains why the clown looks so familiar! I think we're onto something!

english: I'll contact the family to verify the truth. If we return the painting, perhaps we'll get a nice reward for reuniting them with a beloved heirloom!
french: Je vais contacter la famille pour vérifier. Si on leur rend ce tableau, il y aura une jolie récompense à la clé s'il vient bien de chez eux !
russian: Я свяжусь с этой семьёй, чтобы подтвердить догадку. Возможно, если мы вернём картину, нас ждёт неплохая награда за воссоединение с семейной реликвией!
bulgarian: I'll contact the family to verify the truth. If we return the painting, perhaps we'll get a nice reward for reuniting them with a beloved heirloom!

english: One question remains, though... why a clown?
french: Mais une question demeure... Pourquoi un clown ?
russian: Остаётся только вопрос... Почему именно клоун?
bulgarian: One question remains, though... why a clown?

english: This painting is mesmerizing me. There's something about the clown's eyes. Like he's torn between two worlds.
french: Ce tableau me fascine. Le regard de ce clown semble dire qu'il est coincé entre deux mondes.
russian: Эта картина меня завораживает. У клоуна такие необыкновенные глаза. Будто он разрывается меж двух миров.
bulgarian: This painting is mesmerizing me. There's something about the clown's eyes. Like he's torn between two worlds.

english: The good news is that we solved the mystery! This painting was indeed commissioned by the late Lord Hawthorne.
french: La bonne, c'est que nous avons percé le mystère ! Ce tableau a bien été commandé par feu le seigneur Hawthorne.
russian: Хорошая новость в том, что мы разгадали загадку! Эту картину действительно заказывал покойный лорд Хоторн.
bulgarian: The good news is that we solved the mystery! This painting was indeed commissioned by the late Lord Hawthorne.

english: All yours, [Ari]. This clown was giving me nightmares.
french: Je te le laisse volontiers, [Ari]. Ce clown me donne des cauchemars.
russian: Пожалуйста, [Ari]. У меня от этого клоуна кошмары.
bulgarian: All yours, [Ari]. This clown was giving me nightmares.

english: Great. Let's bury it somewhere... funny. I think Hawthorne would have liked that.
french: Super. Alors, enterrons-le dans un endroit... rigolo. Je pense que c'est ce qu'Hawthorne aurait voulu.
russian: Чудно. Давайте закопаем в местечке... посмешнее. Думаю, Хоторну бы это понравилось.
bulgarian: Great. Let's bury it somewhere... funny. I think Hawthorne would have liked that.

english: A mystery well-solved, everyone! Congratulations.
french: Bravo à tous pour cette enquête rondement menée !
russian: Загадка с блеском решена! Поздравляю.
bulgarian: A mystery well-solved, everyone! Congratulations.

english: No kidding! I'm impressed with all of you.
french: Honnêtement, vous m'avez tous impressionné.
russian: Это точно! Вы все меня впечатлили.
bulgarian: No kidding! I'm impressed with all of you.

english: And now I know exactly who to call next time I have a hideous, unsellable painting on my hands.
french: Je saurai donc à qui m'adresser la prochaine que je me retrouverai avec un tableau hideux sur les bras.
russian: И теперь я точно знаю, кого звать, если у меня окажется зловещая картина, которую невозможно продать.
bulgarian: And now I know exactly who to call next time I have a hideous, unsellable painting on my hands.

english: He was a politician who moonlighted as a clown... his true passion.
french: C'était un homme politique qui aimait se déguiser en clown... C'était sa véritable passion.
russian: Он был политиком, но работал клоуном на стороне... Это была его настоящая страсть.
bulgarian: He was a politician who moonlighted as a clown... his true passion.

english: We did it!
french: On a réussi !
russian: Мы догадались!
bulgarian: We did it!

english: And the bad news?
french: Et la mauvaise nouvelle ?
russian: А плохая новость?
bulgarian: And the bad news?

english: The family is aware of the painting... and despises it.
french: C'est que la famille connaît l'existence de ce tableau... et qu'elle le déteste.
russian: Его семья знает про эту картину... И ненавидит её.
bulgarian: The family is aware of the painting... and despises it.

english: Oh. I suppose his descendants want nothing to do with their clownish history...
french: Oh. J'imagine que ses descendants ne veulent pas qu'on mêle leur famille à cette histoire de clown...
russian: Ох. Полагаю, его потомкам не нужны клоуны в родословной...
bulgarian: Oh. I suppose his descendants want nothing to do with their clownish history...

english: So... what do we do with it?
french: Alors, on en fait quoi ?
russian: Так... И что нам с ней делать?
bulgarian: So... what do we do with it?

english: Well, the Hawthornes said it was a political liability. They want it destroyed.
french: Eh bien, les Hawthorne le voient comme une menace pour leur carrière politique. Ils veulent qu'on le détruise.
russian: Ну, Хоторны сказали, что это политическая обуза. Они хотят, чтобы её уничтожили.
bulgarian: Well, the Hawthornes said it was a political liability. They want it destroyed.

english: I don't have the heart to do that, but maybe we can bury it. I'll get a shovel.
french: Je n'ai pas le cœur à faire ça... On pourrait peut-être l'enterrer à la place ? J'irai chercher une pelle.
russian: Я не решусь с ней так поступить, но, может, мы её закопаем? Я схожу за лопатой.
bulgarian: I don't have the heart to do that, but maybe we can bury it. I'll get a shovel.

english: Wait! I'll take it!
french: Attendez ! Moi, je le garde !
russian: Погодите! Я её заберу!
bulgarian: Wait! I'll take it!

english: That's probably for the best.
french: C'est mieux comme ça.
russian: Да, так будет лучше.
bulgarian: That's probably for the best.

english: Good evening, my detectives! I come bearing good news and bad news.
french: Bonsoir, chers détectives ! J'ai une bonne et une mauvaise nouvelle pour vous.
russian: Добрый вечер, детективы! У меня есть одна хорошая новость и одна плохая.
bulgarian: Good evening, my detectives! I come bearing good news and bad news.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_1/1
english: I think Dell is pretending to be a... standoffish cat? Or is she pretending to be March?
french: Je crois que Dell imite un... chat farouche ? Ou March ?
russian: По-моему, Делл изображает... надменного кота? Или это Март?
bulgarian: I think Dell is pretending to be a... standoffish cat? Or is she pretending to be March?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_1/init
english: Are the kids playing a game up on the balcony?
french: À quoi est-ce que les enfants jouent sur le balcon ?
russian: У детей на балконе какая-то игра?
bulgarian: Are the kids playing a game up on the balcony?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_2/1
english: Their faces are so intense, I'm getting chills! Ooh, I hope they crack the case!
french: Ils font une de ces têtes, j'en ai des frissons ! Oh, j'espère qu'ils vont mener à bien leur enquête !
russian: У них такие напряжённые лица, у меня аж мурашки! Ух, вот бы они раскрыли это дело!
bulgarian: Their faces are so intense, I'm getting chills! Ooh, I hope they crack the case!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_2/init
english: That table over there... Balor, Nora and company. They look like they're trying to solve some kind of mystery.
french: Regarde la table de Balor, Nora et compagnie. On dirait qu'ils essaient de résoudre une sorte de mystère.
russian: Вон за тем столом... Балор, Нора и компания. Кажется, они разгадывают какую-то тайну.
bulgarian: That table over there... Balor, Nora and company. They look like they're trying to solve some kind of mystery.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_3/1
english: Sure does. I wonder what kind of adventure Elsie's got in store for them this week?
french: Oui. Je me demande ce qu'Elsie leur réserve comme aventure cette semaine...
russian: Это точно. Интересно, что за приключение на этой неделе им приготовила Элси?
bulgarian: Sure does. I wonder what kind of adventure Elsie's got in store for them this week?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_3/init
english: The game table looks like it's heating up, doesn't it?
french: Ça a l'air de chauffer à la table de jeu, non ?
russian: Кажется, за игровым столом накаляется обстановка.
bulgarian: The game table looks like it's heating up, doesn't it?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_4/1
english: Oh, come now dear. It was Eiland's scheme for sharing unlimited desserts.
french: Allons, mon chéri. Ça permet surtout à Eiland de manger des desserts autant qu'il veut.
russian: Ой, перестань, дорогой. Это план Эйланда по раздаче бесконечных десертов.
bulgarian: Oh, come now dear. It was Eiland's scheme for sharing unlimited desserts.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 4/Inn Crew/inn_crew/inn_crew_4/init
english: You don't suppose the desserts club was Eiland's scheme for getting unlimited desserts, do you?
french: Tu ne crois pas qu'Eiland se sert de ce club des desserts pour en avoir à volonté ?
russian: Ты же не думаешь, что клуб десертов — это хитрый план Эйланда по получению бесконечных бесплатных десертов?
bulgarian: You don't suppose the desserts club was Eiland's scheme for getting unlimited desserts, do you?

english: But we'll make up for it with plenty of drama! Let's get started shall we? Everyone grab one of these note cards I've prepared, each will describe your character's secret lover!
french: Mais elle sera riche en rebondissements ! Tout le monde est prêt ? Prenez chacun une des cartes que j'ai préparées. Elles décrivent la situation amoureuse de votre personnage !
russian: Но зато перепалок у нас будет в изобилии! Давайте начнём. Я приготовила каждому по заметке, там описан ваш тайный любовник.
bulgarian: But we'll make up for it with plenty of drama! Let's get started shall we? Everyone grab one of these note cards I've prepared, each will describe your character's secret lover!

english: Penelope? Just like that? I thought I was too grizzled to be this devastated.
french: Pénélope ? Me quitter comme ça, sans prévenir ? Je pensais être trop endurci pour avoir le cœur brisé un jour.
russian: И забыла? Вот так просто? Ох, не думал, что в мои годы я могу так обмануться.
bulgarian: Penelope? Just like that? I thought I was too grizzled to be this devastated.

english: Pen would never break up with me in this manner. There must be something else going on!
french: Ma Pépé ne m'aurait jamais quittée de cette manière. Il se passe forcément quelque chose !
russian: Белла не могла со мной так поступить. Здесь явно что-то не так!
bulgarian: Pen would never break up with me in this manner. There must be something else going on!

english: Was Penny playing with Goldwolf's heart? Is this even how you're supposed to play this game? Goldwolf feels rage and sorrow, and wants answers!
french: Pénélope a-t-elle joué avec le cœur de Louvedor ? Est-ce de cette manière qu'on est censés jouer à ce jeu ? Louvedor ressent de la rage et du chagrin. Elle exige des réponses !
russian: Выходит, для Беллы Златоклык — лишь игрушка? Разве у нас такие правила? Златоклык чувствует ярость и печаль, ей нужны ответы!
bulgarian: Was Penny playing with Goldwolf's heart? Is this even how you're supposed to play this game? Goldwolf feels rage and sorrow, and wants answers!

english: Whoa, guys... hang on...
french: Hé... une petite minute...
russian: Ой, ребята... постойте...
bulgarian: Whoa, guys... hang on...

english: Were we all dating the same person?
french: Est-ce qu'on était tous en couple avec la même personne ?
russian: Мы что, все назначили свидание с одной девушкой?
bulgarian: Were we all dating the same person?

english: Kid, I think you're onto something.
french: Je crois que tu as vu juste, gamin.
russian: Дело говоришь, парень, тут что-то нечисто.
bulgarian: Kid, I think you're onto something.

english: Just who are you, Penelope Lovestruck?
french: Mais qui es-tu, Pénélope Brisecœur ?
russian: Кто же ты такая, Изабелла Монамур?
bulgarian: Just who are you, Penelope Lovestruck?

english: Now, I'll set the scene. You're all at the same restaurant, awaiting the arrival of your respective dates. The atmosphere is cheerful, and you've got to chatting.
french: Je plante le décor : vous êtes tous dans un restaurant. Vous attendez chacun la personne avec qui vous avez un rendez-vous galant. L'atmosphère est détendue, vous discutez.
russian: Теперь опишем сцену. Вы все собрались в одном ресторане и ждёте свою пару на свидание. В дружелюбной атмосфере вы завели досужий разговор.
bulgarian: Now, I'll set the scene. You're all at the same restaurant, awaiting the arrival of your respective dates. The atmosphere is cheerful, and you've got to chatting.

english: The waiter poses a friendly question: Who are you? and what is it that you love about your secret date?
french: Le serveur vous demande si vous pouvez vous présenter et dire ce que vous aimez chez la personne que vous attendez ?
russian: Официант учтиво спрашивает: «Как вас зовут? И чем вас привлекает ваша тайная любовь?»
bulgarian: The waiter poses a friendly question: Who are you? and what is it that you love about your secret date?

english: The name's Chip Rosewood, retired detective. It's hard to find someone who really gets you in my line of work. And according to this here note card, she knows how to hold her liquor to boot!
french: Je suis Derrick Navarro, ancien détective à la retraite. C'est difficile de trouver une femme qui vous comprend quand on fait ce métier. Et d'après cette carte, elle tient bien l'alcool !
russian: Я Палисандр Струж, детектив в отставке. С моей работой трудно найти человека, который тебя по-настоящему понимает. И в заметке написано, что она знает толк в выпивке!
bulgarian: The name's Chip Rosewood, retired detective. It's hard to find someone who really gets you in my line of work. And according to this here note card, she knows how to hold her liquor to boot!

english: I am known as the sorceress Anelace. My darling has an inquisitive mind! She always asks after my latest spells, and she's even inspired me to create some new ones... apparently.
french: On m'appelle Anelace la sorcière. Mon amoureuse a l'esprit curieux ! Elle veut toujours que je lui explique mes derniers sorts et elle m'en inspire même de nouveaux... apparemment.
russian: Я чародейка по имени Анелас. У моей возлюбленной пытливый ум! Она любит расспрашивать меня о моих заклинаниях, и даже вдохновила меня на создание новых... как тут написано.
bulgarian: I am known as the sorceress Anelace. My darling has an inquisitive mind! She always asks after my latest spells, and she's even inspired me to create some new ones... apparently.

english: I'm Goldwolf, a barbarian warrior! Goldwolf loves her girlfriend because she's hotter than the volcanoes that rise above her homeland.
french: Je suis Louvedor, une guerrière barbare ! Louvedor aime sa petite amie parce qu'elle est plus torride que les volcans de sa terre natale.
russian: Я Златоклык, воин-варварша! Златоклык любит свою девушку, потому что она горячее вулканов на её родине.
bulgarian: I'm Goldwolf, a barbarian warrior! Goldwolf loves her girlfriend because she's hotter than the volcanoes that rise above her homeland.

english: Right on, Goldwolf. I'm Rocky, a wandering monk who worships the buffest god, Musculor. I met my girl at the monastery gym! She's strong!
french: Je suis Pierrick, un moine voyageur qui vénère Musculor, le dieu de la musculation. J'ai rencontré ma copine à la salle de gym du monastère. Elle a une sacrée poigne !
russian: Отлично, Златоклык. Я Булыж, бродячий монах, поклоняющийся самому накачанному богу — Мускулору. Я встретил свою девушку в спортзале при храме! Она очень сильная!
bulgarian: Right on, Goldwolf. I'm Rocky, a wandering monk who worships the buffest god, Musculor. I met my girl at the monastery gym! She's strong!

english: The waiter listens raptly, until he's distracted by a messenger with a letter. He frowns, and reads the letter aloud.
french: Le serveur écoute attentivement, jusqu'à ce qu'il soit interrompu par un messager qui apporte une lettre. Il fronce les sourcils et la lit à voix haute.
russian: Официант увлечённо слушает вас, но его неожиданно отвлекает посыльный с письмом. Он хмурится и зачитывает вслух:
bulgarian: The waiter listens raptly, until he's distracted by a messenger with a letter. He frowns, and reads the letter aloud.

english: "To whom it concerns: Forgive me for missing our date. Things must end between us. Don't come looking for me. Signed, Penelope Lovestruck."
french: « À qui de droit : désolée de ne pas pouvoir honorer notre rendez-vous. C'est fini entre nous. Ne viens pas me chercher. Signé, Pénélope Brisecœur. »
russian: «Получателю сего: прости, что пропускаю встречу. Между нами всё кончено. Не ищи меня. Изабелла Монамур».
bulgarian: "To whom it concerns: Forgive me for missing our date. Things must end between us. Don't come looking for me. Signed, Penelope Lovestruck."

english: Oh, I'm so excited to be running this round of Dragons and Drama! Though if I'm honest, this campaign is a little light on the dragons.
french: Je suis ravie de vous accueillir dans cette partie de Désirs & Dragons ! Même si, reconnaissons-le, il y aura assez peu de dragons dans la campagne.
russian: Ох, я так предвкушаю, как буду проводить этот сезон «Перепалок & Драконов»! Хотя, если честно, драконов в этой кампании не очень много.
bulgarian: Oh, I'm so excited to be running this round of Dragons and Drama! Though if I'm honest, this campaign is a little light on the dragons.

english: Your shared purpose is to find answers to the mystery of Penelope Lovestruck... but a close second is brunch.
french: Tous ensemble, vous devez percer le mystère de Pénélope Brisecœur... mais leur brunch se pose là aussi.
russian: Ваша главная цель: разгадать тайну Изабеллы Монамур... а другая — второй завтрак.
bulgarian: Your shared purpose is to find answers to the mystery of Penelope Lovestruck... but a close second is brunch.

english: The fellow keeps peeking over at you, but he's being awfully subtle about it. It's only due to your years of experience that you've noticed.
french: L'homme vous glisse des regards furtifs. C'est uniquement grâce à vos années d'expérience que vous l'avez remarqué.
russian: Этот парень постоянно на вас оборачивается, но тщательно старается это скрыть. Только благодаря многолетнему опыту ты смог это углядеть.
bulgarian: The fellow keeps peeking over at you, but he's being awfully subtle about it. It's only due to your years of experience that you've noticed.

english: Oh, should I not be waving at him?
french: Oh, devrais-je lui faire signe ?
russian: Ой, мне не стоит ему махать, да?
bulgarian: Oh, should I not be waving at him?

english: That must be why he's getting his things together rather quickly. We should follow him.
french: C'est sûrement pour cette raison qu'il rassemble ses affaires à la va-vite avant de déguerpir. On ferait mieux de le suivre.
russian: Наверное, поэтому он стал так быстро собирать вещи. Надо отправиться за ним.
bulgarian: That must be why he's getting his things together rather quickly. We should follow him.

english: Yeehaw! It's on! We'll find you, Penelope!
french: Oui, je m'en charge ! On te retrouvera, Pénélope !
russian: Ю-ху! Началось! Мы найдём тебя, Изабелла!
bulgarian: Yeehaw! It's on! We'll find you, Penelope!

english: Sorceress Anelace finds a refreshing morning salad is the most efficient way to keep her mana topped up.
french: Anelace la sorcière découvre qu'une salade rafraîchissante de bon matin est le meilleur moyen de recharger son mana.
russian: Чародейка Анелас полагает, что свежий овощной салат с утра — лучший способ пополнить запас маны.
bulgarian: Sorceress Anelace finds a refreshing morning salad is the most efficient way to keep her mana topped up.

english: Goldwolf thinks Anelace is not very well-versed in the intricacies of mana management. Maybe she'd like pointers.
french: Louvedor pense qu'Anelace n'y connaît pas grand-chose en matière de mana. Peut-être a-t-elle besoin de conseils ?
russian: Златоклык считает, что Анелас плохо разбирается в управлении магическими ресурсами. Может, ей подсказать?
bulgarian: Goldwolf thinks Anelace is not very well-versed in the intricacies of mana management. Maybe she'd like pointers.

english: Anelace isn't about to start taking magical instruction from a barbarian.
french: Anelace n'a pas de conseils à recevoir d'une barbare sur la magie.
russian: Анелас не будет слушать магические советы от варварши!
bulgarian: Anelace isn't about to start taking magical instruction from a barbarian.

english: Pass those hard-boiled eggs, Chip. They look so good after a long morning of muscle prayers at the temple bench press!
french: Passe-moi les œufs durs, Derrick. Je dois reprendre des forces après ma longue prière au dieu de la musculation, au temple !
russian: Струж, передай, пожалуйста, крутые яйца. Они так аппетитно выглядят после утренней молитвы мышц в храме отжиманий!
bulgarian: Pass those hard-boiled eggs, Chip. They look so good after a long morning of muscle prayers at the temple bench press!

english: Alright, enough chit-chat! Penelope was a regular at this very diner. I've been showing this drawing of her around, and that man at the counter had a very interesting reaction.
french: Bon, assez discuté ! Pénélope avait ses habitudes dans cette auberge. J'ai montré ce dessin d'elle à plusieurs personnes, et cet homme au comptoir a eu une réaction très intéressante.
russian: Ладно, хватит болтать. Изабелла часто заходила в это кафе. Я показывал местным её портрет, и у вон того мужчины за стойкой была весьма необычная реакция.
bulgarian: Alright, enough chit-chat! Penelope was a regular at this very diner. I've been showing this drawing of her around, and that man at the counter had a very interesting reaction.

english: Goldwolf thinks his reaction may be due to your terrible drawing.
french: Louvedor pense que cette réaction est due au dessin en lui-même, qui est particulièrement laid.
russian: Златоклык думает, что его реакция была, наверное, на твой ужасный рисунок.
bulgarian: Goldwolf thinks his reaction may be due to your terrible drawing.

english: It's quite abysmal.
french: C'est une horreur.
russian: Он и правда чудовищный.
bulgarian: It's quite abysmal.

english: Ah, everyone's a critic. I roll to surreptitiously observe the suspicious man. What's an eleven do for us?
french: Je suis en compagnie de critiques d'art, à ce que je vois. Je lance le dé pour observer discrètement le type en question. Un 11, ça fait quoi ?
russian: Ах, какие тут все знатоки! Я делаю бросок на скрытное наблюдение за этим подозрительным человеком. Одиннадцать — что у меня вышло?
bulgarian: Ah, everyone's a critic. I roll to surreptitiously observe the suspicious man. What's an eleven do for us?

english: One week has passed, and your group of circumstance has gathered at a diner.
french: Une semaine a passé et votre groupe uni par les circonstances se retrouve dans une auberge.
russian: Прошла неделя, и ваша случайная компания собралась в кафе.
bulgarian: One week has passed, and your group of circumstance has gathered at a diner.

english: But lo! An oxcart blocks the street in front of you! You watch helplessly as your quarry disappears into the crowd beyond.
french: Mais regardez ! Une charrette à bœufs bloque la rue en face de vous ! Impuissants, vous regardez votre cible disparaître dans la foule.
russian: Как вдруг перед вашим носом дорогу преграждает воловья упряжка! В полной беспомощности вы видите, как ваша цель растворяется в толпе.
bulgarian: But lo! An oxcart blocks the street in front of you! You watch helplessly as your quarry disappears into the crowd beyond.

english: His disorientation is an advantage for my spell of truth! I weave it around him before he has a chance to get his thoughts in order.
french: Sa désorientation est un avantage pour mon sort de vérité ! Je l'ensorcelle avant qu'il ait le temps de reprendre ses esprits.
russian: Его растерянность даёт мне преимущество на заклинание правды! Я быстро произношу его, пока он не успел привести мысли в порядок.
bulgarian: His disorientation is an advantage for my spell of truth! I weave it around him before he has a chance to get his thoughts in order.

english: Goldwolf would like to point out that truth is better extracted with a potion than a spell.
french: Louvedor tient à souligner qu'une potion vaut mieux qu'un sort pour obtenir la vérité de quelqu'un.
russian: Златоклык спешит отметить, что правду эффективнее извлекать не заклинанием, а зельем.
bulgarian: Goldwolf would like to point out that truth is better extracted with a potion than a spell.

english: Anelace would like to point out that she doesn't tell Goldwolf how to throw heavy objects.
french: Anelace tient à souligner qu'elle ne dit pas à Louvedor comment lancer des objets lourds.
russian: Анелас спешит отметить, что она не даёт Златоклыку советов, как надо бросать тяжёлые предметы.
bulgarian: Anelace would like to point out that she doesn't tell Goldwolf how to throw heavy objects.

english: The truth comes out slowly, carefully, as though the man is piecing it together himself.
french: La vérité sort doucement, prudemment, comme si l'homme la reconstituait lui-même.
russian: Правда выходит наружу медленно и осторожно, как будто этот мужчина сам до неё только додумался.
bulgarian: The truth comes out slowly, carefully, as though the man is piecing it together himself.

english: Penelope Lovestruck was a spy for the crown, and this man is Hans, her handler! If she's missing, it means something's gone terribly wrong.
french: Pénélope Brisecœur était une espionne de la couronne, et cet homme est Hans, son chef ! Si elle a disparu, ça signifie qu'il s'est passé quelque chose de grave.
russian: Изабелла Монамур была королевской шпионкой, а этот мужчина — Ганс, — заведовал её работой! Её пропажа означает крупные неприятности!
bulgarian: Penelope Lovestruck was a spy for the crown, and this man is Hans, her handler! If she's missing, it means something's gone terribly wrong.

english: Hans wants to recruit you to a clandestine effort to get Penelope back... Operation: Lovestruck!
french: Hans souhaite vous recruter pour une opération clandestine visant à ramener Pénélope... L'Opération Brisecœur !
russian: Ганс хочет привлечь вас к секретной миссии по возвращению Изабеллы... «Операция "Монамур"»!
bulgarian: Hans wants to recruit you to a clandestine effort to get Penelope back... Operation: Lovestruck!

english: And here I thought I was retired. Guess it's time... for one last job.
french: Moi qui pensais être à la retraite. Disons qu'il est temps de mener... une dernière enquête.
russian: А я ведь только собрался на пенсию. Что ж, пускай это будет... моё последнее дело.
bulgarian: And here I thought I was retired. Guess it's time... for one last job.

english: Rats! That was our best lead!
french: Bon sang ! C'était notre meilleure piste !
russian: Проклятье! Это была наша лучшая зацепка!
bulgarian: Rats! That was our best lead!

english: Goldwolf thinks you give up too easily. She lifts the oxcart and throws it aside, roaring the battlecry of her homeland!
french: Louvedor pense que vous abandonnez trop facilement. Elle soulève la charrette à bœufs et la balance sur le côté en hurlant le cri de guerre de ses terres !
russian: Златоклык считает, что вы быстро сдаётесь. Издав боевой рык своей родины, она поднимает повозку вместе с волами и отбрасывает в сторону!
bulgarian: Goldwolf thinks you give up too easily. She lifts the oxcart and throws it aside, roaring the battlecry of her homeland!

english: OHOHOHO!
french: OH HO HO HO !
russian: ОХОХОХО!
bulgarian: OHOHOHO!

english: Oh my! How delightfully unexpected. The melons in the cart are sent flying, and the way is opened to you once more!
french: Mince alors ! Je ne m'attendais pas à ça. Les melons dans la charrette volent dans tous les sens et le passage est à nouveau libre !
russian: О, боже! Какая приятная неожиданность. Арбузы из повозки разлетаются в стороны, но ваш путь снова свободен!
bulgarian: Oh my! How delightfully unexpected. The melons in the cart are sent flying, and the way is opened to you once more!

english: Enhance! I roll to use my Bifocal Eagle Eye, hoping to pick this guy out of the crowd before he's gone for good. Ooh, a high roll! There, Rocky! Get 'im!
french: Amélioration ! Je lance le dé pour utiliser mes binocles à double foyer, en espérant repérer ce type dans la foule avant qu'il ne disparaisse pour de bon. Oh, un gros chiffre ! Vas-y, Pierrick, attrape-le !
russian: Приблизить! Я бросаю, чтобы применять свои Двухфокусные Глаза Ястреба и пытаюсь высмотреть парня в толпе, пока он не убежал. О, хороший бросок! Вон он, Булыж, лови!
bulgarian: Enhance! I roll to use my Bifocal Eagle Eye, hoping to pick this guy out of the crowd before he's gone for good. Ooh, a high roll! There, Rocky! Get 'im!

english: I'm on it! I call on the teachings of Musculor the muscle god to activate the hidden potential of my glutes.
french: J'y vais ! J'implore Musculor, dieu de la musculation, de libérer tout le potentiel de mon fessier.
russian: Уже бегу! Я взываю к наставлениям Мускулора, бога мышц, и использую скрытый потенциал своих ягодиц.
bulgarian: I'm on it! I call on the teachings of Musculor the muscle god to activate the hidden potential of my glutes.

english: I vault over the crowd, kicking off of a fruit stand so I can grab one of those melons in mid-air! I roll to throw it at him!
french: Je saute par-dessus la foule. Je fais voler un étal de fruits pour attraper un des melons en plein vol ! Je lance le dé pour le lui balancer !
russian: Я отталкиваюсь от прилавка с фруктами и прыгаю над толпой, подхватывая один из летящих арбузов! Бросаю кубик, чтобы швырнуть в него арбузом!
bulgarian: I vault over the crowd, kicking off of a fruit stand so I can grab one of those melons in mid-air! I roll to throw it at him!

english: Your roll isn't high, but this is so delightful I'll allow it. The mighty melon sends the man prone. He's startled, and covered in a fine patina of cantaloupe.
french: C'est un résultat faible, mais je suis si contente que ça fonctionne. Le puissant melon fait tomber l'homme. Il est sonné et couvert du fruit.
russian: Маловато, но затея такая прелестная, что я уступлю. Мощный удар сбивает мужчину с ног. Он ошеломлён и покрыт густым слоем арбузной мякоти.
bulgarian: Your roll isn't high, but this is so delightful I'll allow it. The mighty melon sends the man prone. He's startled, and covered in a fine patina of cantaloupe.

english: Your motley crew bursts out of the diner, in pursuit of the suspicious fellow who balked at Chip's drawing of Penelope Lovestruck.
french: Votre joyeuse bande sort en trombe du restaurant, sur les traces de l'homme suspect qui a réagi au portrait de Pénélope Brisecœur réalisé par Derrick.
russian: Ваша пёстрая компания вываливается из кафе в погоне за подозрительным типом, который с сомнением смотрел на рисунок Изабеллы Монамур, сделанный Стружем.
bulgarian: Your motley crew bursts out of the diner, in pursuit of the suspicious fellow who balked at Chip's drawing of Penelope Lovestruck.

english: You've found Penelope, and she wasn't captured at all! She fell in love with the agent of a rival nation, and fled because her handler, Hans, branded her a traitor.
french: Vous avez retrouvé Pénélope. Elle n'avait pas été capturée ! Elle était tombée amoureuse d'un espion étranger et elle s'est enfuie après que son officier traitant, Hans, l'a qualifiée de traîtresse.
russian: Вы нашли Изабеллу отнюдь не в плену врага! Оказывается, она влюбилась в агента враждебной страны и сбежала, когда её надзиратель Ганс обвинил её в предательстве.
bulgarian: You've found Penelope, and she wasn't captured at all! She fell in love with the agent of a rival nation, and fled because her handler, Hans, branded her a traitor.

english: The spell wipes the man's mind! Penelope and her love abscond into the night, to start their new life.... At least until she's bored again.
french: Le sort efface la mémoire de l'espion ! Pénélope et son amant s'enfuient dans la nuit pour démarrer une nouvelle vie.... Du moins, jusqu'à ce qu'elle commence à s'ennuyer.
russian: Его разум опустошён заклинанием! Изабелла и её возлюбленный исчезают в ночи, чтобы начать новую жизнь... По крайней мере, пока он ей не наскучит.
bulgarian: The spell wipes the man's mind! Penelope and her love abscond into the night, to start their new life.... At least until she's bored again.

english: And it's all thanks to you warriors of the heart!
french: Et tout ça, c'est grâce à vous, valeureux guerriers éconduits !
russian: И всё благодаря вам — воителям сердец!
bulgarian: And it's all thanks to you warriors of the heart!

english: Wonderful, wonderful! I've never done an interactive story before, but you made it such fun!
french: C'est merveilleux ! Je n'avais jamais participé à un récit interactif avant, et j'ai trouvé ça époustouflant !
russian: Чудесно, чудесно! Я ещё не пробовала делать интерактивные истории, но с вами было так весело!
bulgarian: Wonderful, wonderful! I've never done an interactive story before, but you made it such fun!

english: You did a great job, Elsie. I was thinking about the adventures of Chip Rosewood all week, every week!
french: Bravo, Elsie. Je n'ai fait que repenser aux aventures de Derrick Navarro toutes les semaines !
russian: У тебя отлично получилось, Элси. После каждой встречи я всю неделю думал о приключениях Палисандра Стружа!
bulgarian: You did a great job, Elsie. I was thinking about the adventures of Chip Rosewood all week, every week!

english: That warms my heart. And you know, this adventure was largely autobiographical.
french: Ça me fait chaud au cœur. Et vous savez quoi, cette aventure était en grande partie inspirée de mon histoire.
russian: Твои слова греют мне душу. И знаешь, ведь по большей части это приключение автобиографично.
bulgarian: That warms my heart. And you know, this adventure was largely autobiographical.

english: I see! Wait, what?
french: Ah, d'accord ! Euh... quoi ?
russian: Понимаю! Погоди, что?
bulgarian: I see! Wait, what?

english: Somehow, Goldwolf is not surprised.
french: Bizarrement, Louvedor n'est pas surprise.
russian: Златоклык почему-то уже не удивлена.
bulgarian: Somehow, Goldwolf is not surprised.

english: In fact, Penelope seems quite repentant. And torn. She loved Chip Rosewood's reliable experience, and adored Anelace's boundless curiosity.
french: Pénélope semble s'en vouloir, elle est tiraillée. Elle aimait Derrick Navarro pour sa grande expérience, ainsi qu'Anelace pour sa curiosité sans limites.
russian: Изабеллу же, напротив, мучает совесть. Она любила Палисандра Стружа за надёжный опыт и Анелас за её необузданное любопытство.
bulgarian: In fact, Penelope seems quite repentant. And torn. She loved Chip Rosewood's reliable experience, and adored Anelace's boundless curiosity.

english: She was fascinated by Goldwolf's stories of her barbarian homeland, and she was enthralled by the strength of Rocky's brain.
french: Elle était fascinée par les histoires de Louvedor sur ses origines barbares et elle admirait la force d'esprit de Pierrick.
russian: Она восхищалась рассказами Златоклык о её родных землях варваров и была очарована мощью мозгов Булыжа.
bulgarian: She was fascinated by Goldwolf's stories of her barbarian homeland, and she was enthralled by the strength of Rocky's brain.

english: Sigh... she always was a sweetheart, that Penelope. Well, folks... I think we know what we have to do.
french: Ah là là... Pénélope a toujours été si adorable avec moi. Les amis, je crois que nous savons tous ce qu'il nous reste à faire.
russian: Эх... Наша Изабелла всегда была такая милашка. Что ж, ребята... Думаю, мы все знаем, что делать.
bulgarian: Sigh... she always was a sweetheart, that Penelope. Well, folks... I think we know what we have to do.

english: Goldwolf hates betrayal... but loves the juicy drama of forbidden love. Goldwolf votes to keep Hans at bay, so Penny and her newest flame can escape.
french: Louvedor déteste la trahison... mais adore les amours interdites. Louvedor est d'accord pour combattre Hans afin que Pénélope et son nouvel amant puissent s'enfuir.
russian: Златоклык ненавидит предателей... но любит пикантные истории о запретной любви. Она голосует за то, чтобы сдержать Ганса и позволить Белле сбежать к её новой страсти
bulgarian: Goldwolf hates betrayal... but loves the juicy drama of forbidden love. Goldwolf votes to keep Hans at bay, so Penny and her newest flame can escape.

english: I use my powerful brain to headbutt the bad guy, so Anelace has time to cast a cool spell!
french: J'utilise la puissance de mon cerveau pour donner un coup de tête au méchant et pour qu'Anelace ait le temps de lancer un sort !
russian: Используя свой мощный мозг, я бодаю злодея в грудь, давая Анелас время сказать какое-нибудь крутое заклинание!
bulgarian: I use my powerful brain to headbutt the bad guy, so Anelace has time to cast a cool spell!

english: The precepts of my magical school demand that I help anyone in need. I weave a spell of memory obliteration on the spy handler.
french: Les préceptes de mon école de magie m'obligent à aider toute personne en détresse. Je lance un sort d'effacement de la mémoire à l'espion en chef.
russian: Предписания моей магической школы диктуют, что я должна помогать людям в беде. Я накладываю на этого руководителя шпионов уничтожение памяти.
bulgarian: The precepts of my magical school demand that I help anyone in need. I weave a spell of memory obliteration on the spy handler.

english: Unless Goldwolf objects?
french: À moins que Louvedor n'ait une objection ?
russian: У Златоклык нет возражений?
bulgarian: Unless Goldwolf objects?

english: Oh, no. Goldwolf thinks memory obliteration sounds delightful.
french: Aucunement. Louvedor trouve que ce sort est un excellent choix.
russian: О, нет. Златоклык считает, что уничтожение памяти звучит прелестно.
bulgarian: Oh, no. Goldwolf thinks memory obliteration sounds delightful.

english: You've all embarked on Operation: Lovestruck, to save your missing lover and serial dater Penelope Lovestruck. But things have gone horribly awry!
french: Vous avez tous pris part à l'Opération Brisecœur pour retrouver votre amante et séductrice en série, Pénélope Brisecœur, tout est parti en cacahuète.
russian: Вы вместе отправились на «Операцию "Монамур"» по спасению вашей пропавшей, столь непостоянной любовницы Изабеллы Монамур. Но дело приняло трагичный оборот!
bulgarian: You've all embarked on Operation: Lovestruck, to save your missing lover and serial dater Penelope Lovestruck. But things have gone horribly awry!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 5/Capital Club/capital_club_1/capital_club_1/1
english: Then you're in good company!
french: Tu es donc en bonne compagnie !
russian: В таком случае ты в подходящей компании!
bulgarian: Then you're in good company!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 5/Capital Club/capital_club_1/capital_club_1/10
english: And it's so nice to not be mobbed by fans everywhere I go.
french: Et il est si plaisant de ne pas être assaillie par les admirateurs où que j'aille.
russian: И как же приятно побыть вдали от толпы поклонников.
bulgarian: And it's so nice to not be mobbed by fans everywhere I go.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 5/Capital Club/capital_club_1/capital_club_1/11
english: Er, if you say so Elsie.
french: Euh, si tu le dis, Elsie.
russian: Эм, как скажешь, Элси.
bulgarian: Er, if you say so Elsie.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 5/Capital Club/capital_club_1/capital_club_1/2
english: Being Aldaria's largest city, it does mean that many pass through it eventually.
french: Étant donné qu'il s'agit de la plus grande ville d'Aldaria, cela signifie que tout le monde y passe, un jour ou l'autre.
russian: Это ведь крупнейший город в Альдарии. Естественно, многие бывают там проездом.
bulgarian: Being Aldaria's largest city, it does mean that many pass through it eventually.
